name: Half a year ago, I got a musk turtle at home, but then... #turtle #snapping turt
description: type: Video Browsing; caption: Half a year ago, I got a musk turtle at home, but then... #turtle #snapping turtle #pet keeping; ocr: I specially installed one for raising alligator snapping turtles. A week later,; asr: Half a year ago, I got a musk turtle at home. I originally planned to document its entire growth process, but because the enclosure I built for it was a bit too large, I often couldn't find it. Plus, it preferred to be active at night, so there was a time difference between us, and my observation plan fell through. So I decided to get another one. This time I chose an alligator snapping turtle, currently six months old. It prefers daytime activity, and I heard its hunting ability is very strong, which made me curious about its behavior. Considering the growth rate and habits of alligator snapping turtles, this tank setup would be somewhat different. We divided it into three functional areas, including a water area, land area, and basking area, fully catering to the turtle's living needs. For the water area, we used volcanic rock and driftwood to create the foundation, then added some aquatic soil and covered it with sand. The land area was filled with clay balls, which can reduce the risk of mold and provide a suitable environment for beneficial bacteria. Next, I needed to create a basking area for the alligator snapping turtle, so I prepared a stone slab, rinsed it briefly, and placed it on the clay balls, with a few dragon stones around it. Finally, after planting some vegetation, I could add water. To reduce the cleaning burden later, I specifically installed a high-power sponge filter. Besides that, a basking lamp and LED strips were also essential equipment. Alright, the setup part was complete. Next, I needed to let the ecosystem settle for a few days. After a week, the water quality in the tank had stabilized, but before putting the alligator snapping turtle in, I needed to let it acclimate to the water temperature. Half an hour later, the turtle became noticeably more active and started swimming around the tank constantly. It must have been ready to move into its new home. Unlike fully aquatic fish, alligator snapping turtles must regularly surface to breathe, so its first task was to find a suitable breathing spot. Next, it would continue exploring and testing different areas, just to find a better breathing location. The next day, I found it swallowing aquatic soil from the bottom of the tank—it seemed to be hungry, so I immediately fed it a few turtle pellets. After eating its fill, it found a corner and prepared to sleep. When I checked again, I found it resting on top of the filter. It seemed to prefer staying there rather than in the carefully crafted basking area. Perhaps because the basking area was positioned relatively high, and the little guy was still small, it couldn't climb up yet. Fortunately, the space in the tank was spacious enough for it, and with regular feeding, once it grew bigger, it would be able to climb up easily. To help it grow strong, I decided to vary its diet—it couldn't just eat turtle pellets all the time. So I decided to go out and catch some feeder fish for it. I prepared a fish trap, put some hot dogs and bread inside as bait, and threw it into the water. A few hours later, we pulled the trap up, and surprisingly, the harvest was quite good. There were even several different types of fish inside, such as gobies and sculpins. However, there were too many, so I released some. After returning home, I put them all in a quarantine tank I had prepared in advance, because they might carry parasites, and feeding them directly would be risky. Additionally, we also got some frozen fish, which would be fed to the alligator snapping turtle after completely thawing. After two failed attempts, the alligator snapping turtle finally bit down firmly on a feeder fish. I didn't expect this little guy to be quite strong—it even used its claws to help tear the fish apart. After a successful hunt, it brought its prize back to its dwelling to enjoy slowly by itself. A week later, I noticed the feeder fish were noticeably more active. It seemed they were ready to make their sacrifice. Now let's randomly select a lucky one—this is a goby. I brought the container with the goby close to the tank, and the alligator snapping turtle immediately sensed it, its gaze locked tightly on the movement inside the container, showing a strong hunting desire. Then I released the goby into the tank. Unexpectedly, the fish darted directly behind the rocks to hide. Its speed was so fast that the alligator snapping turtle didn't notice at all and kept waiting foolishly near the surface. I had to move the stone slab to create hunting conditions for it. The goby reacted extremely quickly, making a sharp turn and hiding behind the dragon stone, with the alligator snapping turtle in hot pursuit. name: Do you know just how bizarre 8D magical city Chongqing really is? #ChongqingTrav
description: type: Video Browsing; caption: Do you know just how bizarre 8D magical city Chongqing really is? #ChongqingTravelGuide #8DMagicalMountainCityChongqing #TravelRecommendationOfficer #Bizarre; ocr: 8D magical city Chongqing, just how bizarre is it? Do you know? The wavy roads come one wave after another.; asr: Do you know just how bizarre Chongqing really is? One, a single road with seven traffic lights. Navigation systems just give up. Two, an escalator so deep you can't see the bottom, like a space-time tunnel leading to the Earth's core. Three, gas stations built on rooftops. Four, amusement parks constructed in mid-air. Five, a pedestrian bridge between residential buildings 40 meters above ground. Six, parking lots hidden on top of high-rises. Seven, Chongqing hotpot restaurants tucked away 30 meters underground in air-raid shelters. Eight, driving in Chongqing means constantly going in circles like "the magic power of love," spinning until you're dizzy. Nine, U-turns in Chongqing all seem uniformly trained. Ten, cars can take elevators. Eleven, you think you're on the 1st floor, but you're actually on the 22nd. Twelve, buildings actually floating on water. Thirteen, walkways hidden in the gaps between buildings—one wrong step and you're done for. Fourteen, wavy roads with wave after wave, making you question your existence. Fifteen, food stalls operating on the 47th floor. Sixteen, light rail trains passing through buildings. Seventeen, the riverside light rail is like a roller coaster, soaring to the sky, diving underground, weaving through flower fields. Eighteen, Chongqing's absurd bus stops leave you not knowing whether to laugh or cry.; actions: type: watch, play_duration: 3, played_loop_cnt: 0, is_complete_play: False, is_fast_forward_play: False, is_backward_play: False, is_enlarge_play: False

Xiaomei's pursuit of the shadow is blocked by a man from the Resistance, as this is an item bounty hunters use to earn money—selling vampire fangs. The supervisor gave Afu one last chance and ordered Dave to go in and document his violations. Learning from the black market boss, Afu drove at breakneck speed, trying to shake off his pursuers. Just then, a car crashed through the entrance.; asr: This man was bound beneath a steel-reinforced floor, his skin scorched by the sun, when a woman holding an umbrella walked over and extended her arm. The woman's hand also showed burned and festering wounds. It turned out they were both vampires. Lin Xiang was building more nests here for her companions to survive, but was blocked by men from the resistance tribe, so the woman directly ordered workers to bury him alive in cement. However, after nightfall, when the woman returned home, she found a vampire hunter had broken into her residence. Upon seeing the vampire disguised as an old woman, the hunter shot through her abdomen without a word, but the next second the fallen old hag stood right back up, and the wound healed instantly. The hunter tried to shoot again, but the 80-year-old woman could still bend down to dodge bullets, and even her strength and speed were no less than the battle-hardened hunter's. The bounty hunter Afu, kicked flying by the old hag, was thoroughly enraged. He took advantage of a moment to drag her into the sunlight during her sneak attack from behind, but the old hag seemed able to absorb light and was invisible in front of mirrors. Even flattened like paper, she could recover. To quickly end the battle, Afu directly twisted off her waist, then took out a long knife and chopped down, finally dispatching the vampire. But before he could catch his breath, more came from behind with sharp steel wire—the vampire rushing in the next second had his neck sliced off. Then Afu removed their sharp fangs, because these were the items bounty hunters used to earn money. But Afu didn't know this one was actually the daughter of the vampire matriarch. Looking at her dead relative, the vampire Tong Ling Jing Jie shed black tears. A subordinate nearby discovered Afu's blood on the glass. The enraged Jing Jie vowed to find him. Afu encountered another problem—his wife blamed him for not earning money and wanted to take the child back to her mother's place. It turned out Afu had concealed his identity as a bounty hunter, worried about endangering his family, while during the day he had always worked as a swimming instructor. He took the vampire fangs to sell, but since he was expelled from the Hunter's Guild, Afu had to find the black market for trading. The black market boss, seeing Afu desperate for money, took advantage and lowered the fang price to the minimum. To raise 10,000 yuan, he even sold his Air Jordans, but the combined money still wasn't enough. So Afu had to find his friend, Dog Master, wanting to pull connections to get back into the Hunter's Guild. Only by getting back his hunter's license could Afu quickly earn the money. The guild supervisor saw Afu with a face full of complaints, because Afu had repeatedly violated guild rules during his tenure. However, for Dog Master's sake in vouching for him, the supervisor still gave Afu one last chance, but with conditions. After Afu got the new kill list, he headed to the destination with his assistant Dave. They soon arrived at an abandoned bowling alley, which hid a group of newly transformed low-level vampires. Impatient, Afu picked up a shotgun and charged in alone, just in time to see two vampires about to feed on a cat. Afu shot and killed both monsters with his gun, but just as he was about to remove their fangs, both he and Dave received calls from their superior, who, learning that Afu had gone alone to hunt vampires, immediately ordered Dave to go in and record his violations. But just as he walked in, Afu was pinned to the ground by a vampire. With his gun, Afu immediately dealt with the nearby vampire. Dave, who had never seen such a scene, vomited violently. Meanwhile, the vampire Jing Jie found the black market boss's location. Sensing danger, the black market boss tried to pull out his handgun but was stabbed by Jing Jie with a knife and tortured until he revealed information about Afu's whereabouts. Afu realized his beautiful neighbor was talking with a strange man. Dave guessed he was already being targeted by vampires. The next day, Afu continued executing guild missions. name: A lone star in the dark night, lurking for thirty-seven years, extinguished by t
description: type: Video Browsing; caption: A lone star in the dark night, lurking for thirty-seven years, extinguished by the hand of a traitor. #JinWudai #History; ocr: A lone star in the dark night who lurked for 37 years, yet was extinguished by the hand of a traitor. Larry Wu-Tai Chin held a position of power and influence in the CIA, helping China obtain core secrets, but lived his life in the light.; asr: Regardless of time or place, upon discovery, no interrogation needed - execute on the spot. This was China's first global manhunt order issued in 1987, and the target was surprisingly Yu Qiangsheng, former director of the Beijing Municipal Public Security Bureau. In 1985, the traitor Yu Qiangsheng made a phone call to the U.S. CIA, claiming he wanted to report a Chinese spy planted in America. The person he reported was none other than Jin Wudai, an ace agent with the codename "Deep Sea" who had infiltrated the CIA. Upon hearing this name, American intelligence personnel broke out in a cold sweat on the spot. Jin Wudai held a high position in the CIA and had repeatedly achieved great merit, even nearly becoming CIA Director at one point. How could such a person possibly be a spy? Seeing their disbelief, Yu Qiangsheng proposed a face-to-face deal with American agents, with conditions of a large sum of money and personal protection. At the meeting, he handed over a large amount of top-secret files, confirming Jin Wudai's true identity. The Americans immediately arrested Jin Wudai. Facing American interrogation and torture, Jin Wudai remained defiant unto death. To avoid implicating his country, he suddenly made an unexpected request to his guard: "Please give me a plastic bag, I'm not feeling well." In the dead of night, he placed the plastic bag over his head and suffocated himself. Beside him, he left a suicide note with only seven words: "I did not betray my motherland." When news of Jin Wudai's death reached China, it caused a great sensation. It took Jin Wudai thirty-seven years to gain America's trust and become a senior CIA employee. But in the eyes of Chinese soldiers, he was a traitor who sold out his country. He endured countless insulting remarks, yet his patriotic heart never wavered. He provided China with America's strategic assessment of the Korean War, negotiation bottom lines, helped China grasp America's policy baseline in the Taiwan Strait crisis, and leaked classified information about Nixon's decisions on Sino-American relations, providing crucial intelligence for the establishment of diplomatic relations between China and the U.S. Without him, Qian Xuesen might not have been able to return home safely, and China's aerospace program would have been set back at least twenty years. His battlefield always had only him alone, but his heart always held his motherland and people. As for the traitor Yu Qiangsheng, he ultimately could not escape sanctions. Under the global manhunt order, he eventually paid with his life for his betrayal. The hero Jin Wudai deserves to be remembered - he lived in darkness but became the light.; actions: type: watch, play_duration: 3, played_loop_cnt: 0, is_complete_play: False, is_fast_forward_play: False, is_backward_play: False, is_enlarge_play: False | type: like, like_cnt: 1

They take the initiative to build walls, constantly talk about needing a sense of security, yet insist on finding a handsome guy. They proclaim their independence every day, but then ask me for money. They have bad tempers and scrutinize my every detail. They're sensitive and suspicious, and have a bunch of male best friends. They say they don't have any requirements, but they're dissatisfied with everything about me. The most frustrating part is they want me to treat them well and demand I show the right attitude. If I spend too little, they say I'm stingy. If I spend too much, they say I'm not being thoughtful. They love watching my performance, but when I perform, they say it's not romantic enough and that I haven't provided enough sense of ceremony. What they want isn't just material security—they also want you to provide emotional value for them anytime, anywhere, becoming their emotional trash can. You have to pay for the mistakes she made in the past, pay for what her parents owe her, and pay for the guilt her ex-boyfriend caused her. She only makes 3,100 a month but complains that my 10,000 salary is too low. She has no money but loves luxury goods—travel, shopping, afternoon tea, none of it can be missing. On social media, she has to package herself as high-class, refined, and tasteful. In reality, she showers once every three days and is too lazy to change her bedding even when it's gotten grimy from use. She often shares the same pair of Balenciaga socks with her girlfriends and got athlete's foot, then blames me for being unwilling to buy them for her. She plays mahjong every day and says women have it hard. She never cooks and says women are exhausted. She says she doesn't want to become a pitiful woman like her mother. But every time her mom cooks and calls her home to eat, she says, "Mom, you're the best." When chatting with me, it's either "the weather's cold" or "the weather's hot," then "my phone's lagging" or "my screen's cracked." If not that, then it's about rent being due. Out of 365 days a year, she only actively contacts me on birthdays and holidays; the rest of the time she's indifferent. I want to ask everyone: how can you all stand this? Tell me how to find someone. Speak up.; actions: type: watch, play_duration: 1, played_loop_cnt: 0, is_complete_play: False, is_fast_forward_play: False, is_backward_play: False, is_enlarge_play: False

description: type: Video Browsing; caption: Today's Gen Z are really amazing.; ocr: Gen Z is really something. I have these older and younger male cousins, right? Gen Z kids who just stay home playing video games all day. I asked, "He's already this old and you're still supporting him?" They said no, he supports himself. Didn't he used to do design work? I asked why he doesn't go to work then. They said he recently fired his boss. Isn't it super competitive nowadays? His company basically had no principles - they didn't explicitly say you must work overtime, but right before Tomb Sweeping Festival they started this initiative where the leadership would set an example, saying everyone should work overtime for a day, even two days, then continuously for a week. The problem is they don't pay overtime, and there's no rule saying you must work overtime, but everyone formed this consensus: if the leadership works overtime, I work overtime too. But my younger cousin, being Gen Z, is pretty individualistic and self-assertive. After working overtime for a week, on the 6th or 7th day, at 5:30 - they clock out at closing time - right when everyone was getting ready to work overtime, ordering food, preparing to eat at the company, he just turned around and left. People thought maybe he went out to eat, but he never came back. The next day the leadership didn't notice, but after two days of him not showing up, someone probably snitched. The leader called him in for a talk, asking why he wasn't working overtime. He said, "Why don't you pay me overtime then?" They said the company doesn't force you to work overtime. "If the company doesn't force me to work overtime, why should I work overtime?" "Didn't you see that I'm working overtime?" "Oh, so if you work overtime, I have to work overtime too? Sorry, I can't work overtime." And he just walked away. How could the leadership not be angry? But honestly, this kind of thing isn't compliant with regulations either, so the leader was probably hurt but couldn't really say anything. A few days later, it was Tomb Sweeping Festival, a national legal holiday - obviously there should be time off, you know? But on Tomb Sweeping Festival, the leadership announced in the group chat that there would be no holiday tomorrow, asking everyone to work overtime. They said we have this proposal, hoping everyone could set an example - basically using themselves as an example again, meaning "I'm giving up my chance to go home and pay respects to ancestors or take a holiday, hoping everyone can set an example." After the leader said this, even though people complained and cursed privately, they still had to give up the holiday, meaning everyone worked overtime on Tomb Sweeping Festival. But my cousin didn't go again. Not only did he not go, when the leader @'ed him in the group asking why he didn't come, he directly said in the large group chat, "I have to go home to pay respects to my ancestors, I have to sweep the graves. HR sent him something like an email notice saying he didn't comply with company regulations, had an extremely bad attitude, and fired him. The best part is, my aunt is a lawyer. After hearing all this, she didn't say much - "Let's go to labor arbitration." After this was settled, even though he was laid off, after getting the 110,000, word spread within the company. Everyone was saying, "Oh, so we can go to arbitration." The leader said, "You all have money, I know you're rich, but don't show off too much when you come here, don't be too flashy. I'm organizing this dinner, letting all you big Kuaishou influencers and sisters..." He called my mom, including Simba, okay? And Liu Ergou too, yeah Liu Ergou, just these people remaining. There are many other big shots in Sanya too, right? All in Sanya, but they didn't attend this dinner. Everyone can judge for themselves, but today everyone present had beef with Simba, you know? That's why at this place... We six big guys were going at him, he couldn't take it anymore. Erfang said, "Stop it, come eat." They called us to dinner. Big Brother Danbao called us, "Hey, let me tell you. I know you have money, but keep a low profile when eating with me, don't let these big brothers look down on you. Can you understand?" That's the tone he used, then hung up and called everyone one by one. I was so crazy I took a taxi there. The waiter... I have a driver and a Volkswagen in my fleet but I didn't dare use them. I was scared, you know. You know those little carts at the airport? Like the ones for playing golf? You know, right? Sanda and I sat in the back row, I sat here, he sat there, we went in together. Then you sat across from me, and I was pretty relaxed. I saw everyone had arrived, several cars were there already, right? Who was it? But let me tell you, Guazi's image on the internet is really solid. If you want to talk about someone who can make things happen... The leader told me a thousand times not to drive a luxury car there, and then he shows up in a whole airplane. What can you even say about that, brothers? What can you say? He came by plane. From far away I said, let's just say he came by plane first, then we'll talk about what happened at the dinner table. From far away, our plane is just this big. After I finished, I told the leader, "Simba is here." The leader said, "Impossible." The leader was that confident, crossed his legs, "Impossible. I called all of you today and scolded you. Whoever shows off won't have good days ahead." Then in a moment, the plane... Really, brothers, if you haven't been on a helicopter, that sound is deafening, you know? It flew right over our roof. You tell me, isn't this guy out of his mind? All the showing off was done by him at the estate. Man, the vibration and wind were so strong. Finally it circled above the courtyard and landed. Man, let me demonstrate for you, when you go inside again. So much helplessness, so many troubles. Then he got off.; actions: type: watch, play_duration: 3, played_loop_cnt: 0, is_complete_play: False, is_fast_forward_play: False, is_backward_play: False, is_enlarge_play: False

name: Someone who had hemiplegia for nine years is almost being cured by netizens' tea
description: type: Video Browsing; caption: Someone who had hemiplegia for nine years is almost being cured by netizens' teasing #hemiplegia #athlete #summer entertainment #trending topics; ocr: A hemiplegic patient was nearly cured by netizens' antics. You're saying someone who was hemiplegic for 9 years was actually cured by netizens playing around? Xiaodan was unconvinced and came across a blogger who used to be an athlete. Since suffering a cerebral hemorrhage, he had almost forgotten he was once a normal person. But after 3 cerebral hemorrhages, he was left with grade-2 limb hemiplegia as a sequela. His hand would shake violently whenever he exerted force. Initially, the blogger just wanted to post videos documenting his daily life for others with similar conditions to see. Unexpectedly, it went viral, and all he received were suggestions for developing his left hand's skills. Netizens didn't treat him as a patient, nor as an ordinary person. In the comments section, they made all kinds of suggestions: "Your attitude is super great, go work at a university cafeteria serving food to students." "Better than the cafeteria ladies, doesn't leave a drop of soup." "Have him whip egg whites by hand to make snow velvet bean paste." "Put a physical therapy device on his left hand and see if the shaking gets faster or slower." Turns out even at level 15, it wasn't as fast as his own shaking. "Have him brush his teeth with his left hand," and he painlessly got an electric toothbrush effect, merit +1. "Have him tap a wooden fish with his left hand, merit +1." He ended up with a swollen hand. Just like that, under netizens' direction, the blogger conducted two hours of human experiments daily. Just when netizens were having the most fun, the blogger's situation collapsed. The doctor was shocked to discover that the blogger's hemiplegia was about to be cured. "Your results are really quite good, you've recovered very well now. If you actually get better, what are we going to play with?"; asr: You're saying that someone who was hemiplegic for nine years was actually cured by netizens playing around with him. Initially, the blogger just wanted to post videos documenting his daily life for others with similar conditions to see, but unexpectedly went viral. What he received wasn't pity, but rather netizens developing various "skills" for his left hand. Netizens didn't treat him as a patient - they basically didn't treat him as human at all, leaving all sorts of suggestions in the comments: having him serve food in the school cafeteria, doing it even more dramatically than the cafeteria ladies; having him whip egg whites by hand to make red bean paste; having him hold a massage device in his left hand to see if the dog (device) vibrated faster or he shook faster - turns out even at level 15 it couldn't shake as fast as him; having him brush his teeth with his left hand, then trying a painless electric toothbrush, which ended up making his hand swollen. Just like that, under netizens' direction, the blogger conducted two hours of human experiments on himself daily. Before the buyer came to inspect the goods, he would pre-fill the straw's head with premium white powder and secretly help with his hands. Even if he loaded the fake goods from the tail end of the straw and poured it out right in front of them, what came out would only be the top-quality goods from the straw's head. After taking one hit, the underling was instantly shocked by the quality of this batch and couldn't speak for a long time. "Bro, you're amazing." Hearing his underling's praise, Bai Taohua felt relieved, but Bing Adou beside him seemed lost in thought. Just as the other party was about to run off with the money, Bing Adou suddenly called out to them. "Glasses, how many bags in total?" "All swallowed, all hungry." "Teacher, I said all yeah." Just as the fake goods were about to be exposed, urgent police sirens suddenly came from the distance. "You motherfuckers are cops! I'm in my hands, dead is also my brain's doing." Bai Chi had no time to argue about who was the undercover agent. Both groups immediately drove away from the scene. However, Bing Adou hadn't realized yet that this was all a trap set by the other party. Hua Long had already anticipated that the conspiracy might be exposed, so he had his underling hide in the unfinished building in advance. That police siren was actually played through a speaker. "It's over. Hey, I'm bullying you, so what? Go ahead and call the cops again." Faced with their repeated provocations, Bing Adou couldn't take it anymore. With a fierce expression, he made a harsh threat, claiming that the next time they met would be their death day. "I'm afraid you can act, don't just talk, hurry up." After hanging up the phone, Maozi, who had been so arrogant before, started to worry. Since these people dared to touch gambling, it was possible they might come for revenge. So Maozi suggested eliminating the threat at its root by killing Bing Adou first. That night, he found the two brothers, Big Dog and Second Dog, had them disguise as waiters and infiltrate the nightclub, then he called Bing Adou to lure him out. "Bro, I have something to tell you." "That's too bad, I'm not listening. Who the fuck are you? I don't fucking know you at all. Scam call, right? I'm the best at scamming." "Hello? Yes, yes, yes, okay, horny." The accomplice thus became the scapegoat, but Maozi didn't know. Thinking he had eliminated the threat, he boarded the train as usual to pick up the goods. However, he didn't notice that several pairs of eyes on the train were staring intently. These were all Bing Adou's people. After learning of his accomplice's death, he immediately guessed it must have been Hua Long's doing, because they had just arrived in this place and had no other enemies. "Before the incident, I found it very strange. Someone kept trying to lure me out. My little brother blocked it for me, and then he was gone. This must be aimed at us." To get revenge, Bing Adou targeted the job Hua Long was taking on. So just as Big Dog got the drugs, he was deliberately tripped by their people and even accidentally knocked down an old lady. "What's wrong with you? You're not at your own home. Where do you want to stretch your legs? You hit someone." The two got entangled over the incident. The old lady held onto Big Dog tightly, while his accomplice took the opportunity to switch his drug-filled waist bag. Finally, after paying some medical expenses, the old lady stopped pestering Big Dog. At this moment, the unsuspecting Maozi thought he had successfully received the goods. However, just after getting off the train, he suddenly received a phone call. "Brother Maozi, next time there will be interest." He looked around in disbelief because the voice was clearly Bing Adou's. Then the old lady who had been knocked down on the train slowly turned her head. Who would have thought that Bing Adou had disguised himself as an old lady? But he was clearly dead. To figure out what was going on, he immediately had Big Dog take out the goods they picked up. However, when they opened it, inside was a bag of flour with a straw stuck in it—wasn't this the fake goods they had used to scam Bing Adou before? description: type: Video Browsing; caption: The love of the older generation is just this simple and pure #love #love of the older generation #warmth #content inspiration sharing plan; ocr: The old grandmother sensed that she was about to pass away. Grandfather held grandmother's hand, but his heart couldn't let go of his 96-year-old companion. It was filled with grandfather's love for grandmother.; asr: The elderly grandmother sensed her time was near. An hour in advance, she groomed herself, ate a bowl of her favorite noodles, and sat dignified on the sofa. The children, sensing something was wrong, rushed over to check on her. Grandfather, being old and hard of hearing, didn't understand what was happening. Only when he saw his wife being carried away by their children did he slowly realize something was wrong. Grandfather hurriedly moved a chair into the room and gently placed it beside Grandmother. He held her hand without speaking, just feeling her warmth one last time. The double bed they'd shared for a lifetime would now be forever half empty. Longing for someone beyond reach, thinking of someone no longer there. Grandfather's appetite was nothing like before. Every day he lay in familiar places, lost in thought. With no tomorrow to look forward to, this parting meant no return. The 98-year-old grandfather, before his final days, chopped a whole room full of firewood for his 96-year-old grandmother. But he didn't know that right after he passed, Grandmother followed him. They met at 20 and were married for over 60 years, rarely quarreling. Grandmother knew Grandfather loved dumplings, so she often made them for him. Grandfather knew Grandmother loved apricots, so he planted an apricot tree in the yard to ensure she had fresh apricots every year. One day, Grandfather felt extremely weak. He sensed his time was coming, but he couldn't let go of his 96-year-old wife. He feared that without him, Grandmother would have no firewood to cook with. So in his remaining time, Grandfather sat at the door every day chopping firewood for Grandmother. Piece by piece, the wood was neatly stacked under the eaves. But unfortunately, shortly after he passed, Grandmother followed him, leaving behind a room full of neatly stacked firewood. Each piece of wood was worth more than countless roses. It was all filled with Grandfather's love for Grandmother.; actions: type: watch, play_duration: 79, played_loop_cnt: 0, is_complete_play: True, is_fast_forward_play: True, is_backward_play: True, is_enlarge_play: False

I said I really don't have any left, but they still wouldn't leave. They just stood there with that glazed stare, watching me, making it so awkward for me. After a while, these girls each got phone calls and started crying, then they went outside. Less than five minutes later, about 20 people came in and sat right by the door, blocking it completely. I was totally stunned. I said, "What's going on?" Then the tattoo customer said, "It's fine, bro, these are all my friends. Once I'm done with my tattoo, they'll leave with me. My design isn't that big, let me just get it done quickly." I'd only done half when I saw smoke at the entrance. Man, I was so annoyed, I went over there. When they saw me coming, they quickly stomped out the cigarettes. Then I vaguely saw several girls standing in a row over there, just standing around. And a few other girls were rummaging around on that sofa. What were they rummaging for? There was smoke everywhere, I couldn't see clearly, so I didn't pay much attention. Then I went back to continue the tattoo. Just as I was about to finish, there was smoke at the door again. I said I really can't work like this. "Dude," I said, "you come back by yourself tomorrow. Because solving problems for the masses brings enormous benefits, but failing to solve them properly causes enormous damage. If they send you to catch someone and you don't catch up, you'll definitely get kicked by the squad leader when you return. name: This is a carefully disguised collective healing. #gathering #BeijingDrifter #Ac
description: type: Video Browsing; caption: This is a carefully disguised collective healing. #gathering #BeijingDrifter #ActorZhouRui #VlogDaily; ocr: Entertainment industry dinner parties. Dreams and reality of a solo drifter actor in Beijing. What's the point of fussing over this big earthen stove? Paratroopers swimming, another interpretation of dreams.; asr: What ridiculous things happen when a group of jobless actors decide to pool their money to make their own film? Hello everyone, I'm Zhou Rui, an 18th-tier drifter actor in Beijing. Early this morning, my phone notification started going off again in rapid succession. Without even looking, I knew it was that group of unemployed old comrades from the industry coming to mooch meals at my place again. Sure enough, the group chat had already exploded with messages. "Brother Rui, I'll bring two bottles of Huagua as sponsorship." "I just got rejected from an audition and desperately need your cooking to heal my wounds." Looks like there's no escaping it. I hopped on my three-wheeler and rattled all the way to the market. When buying groceries, the vendor asked with a smile, "Having another team-building event today?" I let out a long sigh—you bet. My little courtyard should be renamed "Laid-off Workers Re-employment Training Center." When the brothers arrived, they immediately started chopping firewood for me without a word. But don't get me wrong, it's not that we can't afford coal or gas—it's purely because we old folks love tinkering around that big earthen stove in the yard. Watching them swing those axes with such fierce determination, it's as if they're chopping all their frustrations into the firewood. Actually, everyone understands that each gathering appears to be just joking around, but is really a carefully disguised collective therapy session. While tearing green onions apart with my bare hands, someone started the conversation: "What do you guys think about us making our own film?" I didn't even look up. "Sure, you pay first." "How much?" "Not much, just enough to buy this courtyard, tear it down, and rebuild it three times over." The moment I finished speaking, the air suddenly went quiet for three seconds, then erupted in laughter tinged with bitterness. Honestly, the idea of making our own film—I can come up with several versions of the plan every night when I'm staring at the ceiling counting sheep. But each time I count, I crash back to reality. Why? Two words: no money. Never mind the professional aspects like script, director, and post-production—just calculating the most basic costs of feeding the crew is enough to make my heart sink. Put it this way: a micro-crew trimmed down to the absolute minimum, where you'd want to split each person into eight pieces, needs at least 30 people to function. For accommodation, at the lowest standard of 150 yuan per day for two people per room, just sleeping costs over 2,000 yuan a day. For meals, at 50 yuan per person per day—doesn't sound too high, right? But for 30 people, that's 1,500 yuan a day just for boxed lunches. And these costs are just to keep everyone alive—we haven't even started actually working yet. Even the shortest film takes at least a month and a half to shoot, so these survival costs alone would burn through more than 200,000 yuan. And that's not even counting equipment, venues, costumes, makeup, props, lighting, and so on. So the saying "acting ruins three generations, directing destroys a lifetime" really isn't a joke. We're like umbrella soldiers with dreams, constantly testing the dangerous edges of the entertainment industry, only to find that even one step forward leads only to a dead end. During the meal, someone muttered, "Actually, what we have now isn't so bad." Yeah, although we can't afford professional equipment, at least we can afford good food. Although we can't hire stylists, the lighting in this room adds a touching filter to everyone's face. At this moment, we're not unemployed actors—we're just dreamers gathered around the fire. Maybe tomorrow we'll still have to audition for roles with slim hopes, but at least tonight we have wine, meat, dreams, and eyes brighter than the stars. Our pockets are empty, but our hearts are full. This is probably the truest form of dreamers. Awesome! Follow me!; actions: type: watch, play_duration: 3, played_loop_cnt: 0, is_complete_play: False, is_fast_forward_play: False, is_backward_play: False, is_enlarge_play: False

name: Student in the car: This is what it feels like to have someone backing you up! #
description: type: Video Browsing; caption: Student in the car: This is what it feels like to have someone backing you up! #Instructor #Driving practice #Road test; ocr: Coach Wang from Anshan Driving School. This is exactly what a driving instructor's mouth should be used for - someone who can deal with taxi drivers has finally appeared. You have to understand, when practicing for the road test, beginners are already being very careful. Normal people would give way when they see a learner's car, after all, everyone has been through the beginner stage. But there's always that group of people who see a learner's car driving slowly and just want to cause trouble, honking their horn non-stop. Came across a video of an Anshan instructor whose car was being honked at repeatedly by a taxi behind them. He got out and went off on the taxi driver - now that's what it feels like to have an instructor backing you up! If you want to fly past, go ahead, but why are you honking at a learner's car? Taxi driver: "You're not moving with traffic, if you're not going then why are you honking at me?" Student in the learner's car at this moment: "Exactly!" Instructor: "This is a learner driver, why are you getting worked up over them? Look at you, you could just go straight and loop around, you're in a hurry, right?" This instructor is the real deal - when there's trouble, he actually steps up.; asr: After all these years, someone who dares to mess with a taxi has finally appeared. You have to understand that when practicing for the driving test's third module, beginners are already being very careful, and normal people would give learner cars a wide berth. After all, we've all been beginners before, but there's always that group of people who see a learner car driving slowly and just want to cause trouble, honking their horn non-stop. When an Anshan driving instructor encountered a taxi behind him constantly honking: "Mister, if you're in such a hurry, go around from over there, or fly over if you want. What's it got to do with me? This is someone learning to drive. Why are you bothering to argue with him? What are you doing here with everyone? You're sitting here saying you know how to drive - if you're so good, just go around yourself. You're in a hurry, right? Now you're really getting it."; actions: type: watch, play_duration: 36, played_loop_cnt: 0, is_complete_play: True, is_fast_forward_play: True, is_backward_play: False, is_enlarge_play: False

name: Same job as security guards, some enjoy the music beautifully, while others are
description:
type: Video Browsing; caption: Same job as security guards, some enjoy the music beautifully, while others are nearly deafened #concert #WuBai #ZhangJie #WangYuan; ocr: The sound quality at Wu Bai's Xiamen concert was extremely poor. Security personnel in the inner area covered their ears, looking utterly miserable, because they were too close to the speakers without any soundproofing measures in place. The sound at the Xiamen venue was deafening. Yesterday I saw photos of security guards at Wu Bai's Xiamen concert covering their ears, and today I finally understand why. I was sitting in the fourth row, and out of the first ten or so songs, I had only heard one before - "Tears Bridge." The other songs were torturous to listen to, with the electric guitar sounding piercing. The electric guitar was so piercing that I felt like I was going deaf. I couldn't hear my own voice or others' voices, and I couldn't make out what Wu Bai was singing either. The audience couldn't hear their own voices or others' voices. The sound was very muffled - how could a stadium be like this? The stands were being deafened, and several girls in the front rows also covered their ears. Even audience members in the stands couldn't help but cover their ears. The concert equipment was poor - it was pure torture.

In contrast, Roy Wang's Bird's Nest concert used top-tier German dbSL series sound systems, with each unit costing over 200,000 yuan, requiring hundreds of amplifiers to drive them, with the entire sound system costing over 100 million yuan. In addition to the 4 groups of full-range speakers and 2 groups of bass speakers on the main stage, a complete circle of db supplementary speakers was hung around the top of the Bird's Nest, replacing the Delay Tower sound towers used in other venues. Such a sound system is not only expensive but also frees up obstructed areas and enhances the audience experience.

Zhang Jie's concert sound system cost 240 million yuan, and thoughtfully considered the audience experience by choosing to suspend the speakers. This kind of concert is what audiences are willing to pay for.; asr: When will organizers realize that the lives of workers matter too? At the 500 Xiamen concert, security staff in the inner venue were covering their ears looking utterly miserable. They were so close to the speakers, and the sound quality was absolutely terrible - the electronic and other sounds were piercing. The audience couldn't hear their own voices or others', and even people in the stands couldn't help but cover their ears. Poor concert equipment is pure torture for the audience. It suddenly reminded me that other singers' sound systems cost 200,000, and Zhang Jie's concert sound system even cost 240 million. Moreover, they're considerate and think about the audience experience, choosing to adjust the sound properly. That's the kind of concert audiences are willing to pay for.; actions: type: watch, play_duration: 5, played_loop_cnt: 0, is_complete_play: False, is_fast_forward_play: False, is_backward_play: False, is_enlarge_play: False

description: type: Video Browsing; ocr: Internet celebrity staged a scam in Wuhan, material sourced from the internet, no negative intent. Is it wrong to take them to the nearest place found by navigation and charge the most basic fee? Don't put all the blame on the driver.; asr: Wuhan's culture and tourism sector woke up to a disaster - came across an Inner Mongolia blogger with 110,000 followers who went to Wuhan for fun. Standing on the Yellow Crane Tower overpass wanting to eat fish offal, didn't check the map or use navigation. Directly flagged down a car and told the driver to go to the nearest fish offal restaurant. The driver didn't deceive him or take a detour, honestly used the meter and took him to the nearest place that came up in the search. Turned out after getting out, it was just a few hundred meters from where he got in. The blogger posted two videos in a row with clickbait titles maxed out. The comment section instantly exploded, many people without a second thought directly attacked Wuhan's culture and tourism sector, cursing that Wuhan people are dishonest. Originally thought the taxi driver charged him dozens or hundreds of yuan, but in the end heard that the taxi only charged him the starting fare of ten yuan. Let's talk about logic here - you already got in the car with the meter running, would the driver dare say it's too close, you should walk there? What if you got out and immediately posted a video about refusal of service, where would the driver go to argue their case? Did the driver do anything wrong by following the rules and charging the basic fee? The most speechless part is in the video, constantly saying "we" and "we Inner Mongolians," forcibly turning a personal travel planning mistake into regional conflict. This operation is truly a modern internet scam artist. When traveling, doing your own homework is basic etiquette. Navigation is just a search away, don't dump all the blame on the driver.; actions: type: watch, play_duration: 54, played_loop_cnt: 0, is_complete_play: False, is_fast_forward_play: False, is_backward_play: False, is_enlarge_play: False

description: type: Video Browsing; caption: #Entertainment; ocr: A dog mother's final entrustment. With more love now, child, don't look back. The blogger was awakened by barking sounds while camping. There was no one around, and only after looking around did they discover it was the dog mother leaving reluctantly and painfully. Seeing the blogger walking toward her holding the puppy, the dogs at their home were well cared for, hoping it could live a life with enough food. But the blogger's family raised Jack wolf dogs, and only then did they agree to let the puppy enter their territory. The puppy seemed to sense something too, as if knowing to behave itself. They named it Coal Ball. Having seen a broader world, there were no regrets.; asr: "Child, don't look back. That's the best home I could find for you." A camper was awakened by barking sounds. Upon getting out to check, he discovered a puppy that had just turned one month old. There was no one around, and it was unclear how this puppy had gotten there. The dog mother watched silently from a distance. When she saw the blogger holding the puppy and walking toward her, she left with repeated backward glances. The blogger guessed that the mother dog likely knew she couldn't raise it anymore. Seeing their family camping there, she secretly brought her child over in the early morning hours, hoping it could have a life with enough food to eat. However, the blogger's family raised Jack Russell Terriers with very strong territorial instincts. Only after the dog mother pleaded for a long time did they agree. The blogger didn't abandon the puppy. The mother dog left with reluctance and heartache. The puppy seemed to sense something too, following the blogger closely without barking or fussing, as if knowing that only by being well-behaved could it have a happy home. So the blogger kept it. Not only did it get enough food, but it also got to travel everywhere. It saw a much broader world than its mother had and received more love. But when the blogger later took Meiqi (Coal Ball) back to that place to search for the dog mother, local villagers said she had already passed away. The last time they saw her was the day she entrusted Coal Ball to them—she was searching for food in a garbage bin. "When parents truly love their children, they plan far ahead for them." Presumably, in the dog heaven, knowing that Coal Ball is living well, she has no regrets.; actions: type: watch, play_duration: 26, played_loop_cnt: 0, is_complete_play: False, is_fast_forward_play: False, is_backward_play: False, is_enlarge_play: False

The dog says: You raise me once, I'll ensure you never worry about food and drink for the rest of your life. As for how exactly I'll do that, don't ask.

A netizen's dog used to often run out of the yard to play by itself. One day, it suddenly came back from outside carrying a kitten in its mouth. The cat was very cute and looked like it had just been born not long ago, with a rather weak meow. At first, seeing such an adorable kitten, the netizen was quite happy and was mentally planning how to adopt the little cat. But upon closer inspection, they discovered that what the dog had brought back was a leopard cat, a national second-class protected animal. They quickly went to find the police, wishing they could check the surveillance footage immediately. Even the police officer was quite astonished upon seeing it: "This dog brought this back?" "That's right, it was me." "Master, do you think this is criminal or not?" Just when they thought encountering such an absurd situation was outrageous enough, another dog proved even more unbeatable, directly bringing back a national first-class protected animal for its owner. No one knows how they met, much less how the dog managed to bring it home. When the netizen cautiously greeted it, "Was it you who brought me back?" the little monkey still looked confused, "Who are you?" "Hello, little baby." The dog was still standing in place waiting for praise. "You damn dog, you bring back everything, don't you." He's a little baby, but when it comes to me, I become a damn dog. And here I was thinking of securing you an iron rice bowl.; asr: My dog, I raised you, and in return you ensure I'll have food and drink for the rest of my life - as for how you'll protect me, let's not worry about that for now. This damned kid, jumping around like a monkey - and he did this entirely because the boy was the child of his wife and Old Li. He silently wiped away the soy sauce stains with his sleeve, then put on his hat and left the house in humiliation. Seeing that Zhu Si had been wronged, Seventh Sister-in-law spoke up about how Jiang Qi had no conscience - if it weren't for Zhu Si diligently helping this family, all five of them would have starved long ago. Now that life at home had just improved and the children had grown up, Jiang Laoqi, emboldened, found fault with Zhu Si everywhere. Every time goods arrived at home, he wouldn't give him a pleasant look, telling Seventh Sister-in-law to put everything on the north kang. Zhu Si understood this was all meant to put him in his place - how could he, the "North Kang Warrior," even sleep there? Just sitting there doing nothing - are you trying to spite me?" Meanwhile, the honest Zhu Si was up on the mountain chopping firewood. Seventh Sister-in-law washed herself clean and prepared to go to the north kang, but unexpectedly her husband grabbed her. She firmly shook off his hand. Ever since Jiang Laoqi's health had improved, he had monopolized Seventh Sister-in-law. But tonight she was exceptionally firm - she turned off the light and headed straight for the north kang. description: type: Video Browsing; caption: I thought she was tricked into going to the compound and got electrocuted, but turns out she's the one doing the electrocuting? Even though she's been found, she can't come back now #ChiGuangying #Egypt #Scam; ocr: I thought she had been tricked into going to a compound to be scammed. Turns out she was the one scamming people in the compound. Although Chi Guangying has been found, she can't come back anymore. I thought the missing Chi Guangying had been tricked into going to Egypt to be scammed. My friend's name is Chi Guangying, from Baotou, Inner Mongolia. She flew to Egypt alone on August 6th to live there. For safety reasons, we shared our locations with each other and stayed in daily contact through Douyin or WeChat without interruption. After sharing a Douyin post at 7:11 AM on September 8th, she has been out of contact until now. Her location hasn't been updated for 48 hours, and the location shown is no longer where she lives. I asked people on Douyin to help check the location, but there's no more detailed conclusion. Neither I nor her parents have her passport information or her Egyptian phone number. Her characteristics: tattoos on her chest, forearms and thighs, height around 165 cm, weight around 95 jin. If you are in Egypt, please help me keep an eye out, thank you very much. Missing person: Friends from all over the world, looking for a companion traveling in Egypt. She suddenly lost contact with her family a few days ago. Otherwise my best friend would have been trapped by her by now.; asr: Originally thought that the missing Chi Guangyin had been tricked into going to Egypt for telecom fraud, but unexpectedly she was actually working full-time as a telecom fraud operative in Egypt. The case of the 21-year-old Chinese girl missing in Egypt, which has repeatedly topped trending searches recently, took a major turn today. This Chi Guangyin from Inner Mongolia just graduated from university this year. Unable to find a job, she told her family she wanted to go to Egypt to relax. After being there for a month, she suddenly lost contact with her family a few days ago. Shi Guangning's best friend was the first to step forward, posting help requests across the internet, hoping Chinese people in Egypt could help find her friend. Once the news was released, major media outlets reposted it, and it quickly became a hot search topic. Several Chinese tourists in Egypt put aside their travel plans and went to police stations across Egypt to inquire about Shi Guangying's whereabouts. In the early morning of September 30th, Egyptian police officially responded to the matter. The good news is that Chi Guangyin is still alive; the bad news is that Chi Guangyin has been arrested and may face execution. Because Chi Guangying didn't go to Egypt for tourism at all, but to commit fraud - defrauding Chinese people, luring them to Egypt to kidnap them, then demanding ransom from their families. Egyptian police shut down their fraud den and caught eight accomplices red-handed. Even movie screenwriters wouldn't dare write such a plot. The most ridiculous part is that when Chi Guangyin's mother sought help from netizens, she repeatedly emphasized that her daughter was a good girl. At the time, people said how good could someone be who's only 21 but covered in tattoos? The most speechless person is Chi Guangyin's best friend, because just days before she posted asking for help, Chi Guangying was still inviting her best friend to come to Egypt to keep her company. Fortunately, Egyptian police arrested her, otherwise her best friend would have already been kidnapped by her.; actions: type: watch, play_duration: 83, played_loop_cnt: 0, is_complete_play: True, is_fast_forward_play: False, is_backward_play: True, is_enlarge_play: False | type: like, like_cnt: 1

description: type: Video Browsing; caption: #FastTalkShowReview #NowhereToHide #ContentInspirationSharingPlan; ocr: Brother, you're quite capable, but considering I've committed a capital crime, just give me a bite to eat.; asr: This murderer accidentally discovered that something he had casually picked up could actually save his life, because by this time he had been starving for a day and a night. Then he randomly selected a few photos and wrote some big characters saying "Away from home for two years, suffering," and sure enough, this attracted many passersby to watch. With people throwing ten yuan here and one yuan there, Yang Bing was making money hand over fist in no time, which made him immediately complain a few words. "Hello to Oliver." But unexpectedly, Yang Bin just glanced at him disdainfully and continued stuffing his money. "Big brother Xiang Zong, hero, encountered evil." At this moment, Yang Bin could tell the other party wanted to share his money, but he completely failed to realize the seriousness of the situation. Before long, several burly men came straight toward Yang Bing's location, then squatted down and teased him, "Brother, if you've got the skills..." Before Yang Bing could react, the leader immediately signaled everyone to start attacking. They forcibly dragged Yang Bing to a dead-end alley, then everyone beat him with fists and kicks, and afterward the leader took all the money he had just earned. "I'm telling you, if you come to steal my territory again, I'll kill you." It seemed Yang Bing had stolen business from the beggar gang, which is why he was beaten to this state. At this moment, he couldn't help but burst into tears, experiencing the despair of life on the run, which also completely destroyed his confidence. The scene shifted, and by now Yang Bing had been starving for two days and a night, so hungry he could barely walk straight. He was so hungry he really couldn't hold on anymore. He weakly leaned against a tree, his eyes staring fixedly at the beef noodle shop nearby, his lips so dry that even swallowing saliva was difficult, and then he fainted from hunger. A waitress happened to see this scene and called several colleagues to help, but unexpectedly, when these colleagues saw Yang Bing was a beggar, they turned and left, leaving only the girl alone to show concern for Yang Bing. "What's wrong with you?" After understanding the situation, the kind-hearted girl without a word turned around and brought him a bowl of steaming hot beef noodles. At this moment, Yang Bing looked up at the angel-like beauty before him—this was truly a living Bodhisattva. Only then did Yang Bing begin wolfing down the food. And so, with the beauty's help, Yang Bing escaped death once again. But after finishing the noodles, he limped to the entrance of the local public security bureau, because in his view, there was no other way—he might as well turn himself in. However, thinking that what he had committed was a murder case, and if he turned himself in, there would be no chance of survival, he still chose to continue fleeing. But where to go next was another question. He recalled what a beggar had told him before: "Xiang Zong, hero, Zong oh Miao Miao, your relic is not Ao Zong." Thinking of this, he directly found this beggar, put down his pride, and asked him how to make money. "You know the way, hero, how..." "Brown card just gave birth, like this, grabbed the brown knife card equipment, gave the child a skin-penetrating film." As soon as the beggar finished speaking, he lifted the white cloth on his feet, revealing a pair of complete legs. Now Yang Bin had learned something. Looking at Yang Bin's completely bewildered expression, the beggar directly brought Yang Bin to his boss. "Boss, this is my tribute to you. I still have fingers—please give me a meal to eat."; actions: type: watch, play_duration: 29, played_loop_cnt: 0, is_complete_play: False, is_fast_forward_play: False, is_backward_play: False, is_enlarge_play: False

name: Good Samaritan helps police officer catch suspect, but gets screwed over badly.
description: type: Video Browsing; caption: Good Samaritan helps police officer catch suspect, but gets screwed over badly. #AmericanPoliceEnforcement #Rookie; ocr: Film and TV plot, no negative influence. A rookie cop is arresting a suspect who's struggling like a pig being slaughtered. What the hell is wrong with the radio! Doubts about the rookie cop's professional abilities arise, and before long he changes careers to become a car salesman.; asr: A rookie police officer is arresting a suspect who is struggling like a pig being slaughtered. Just as the suspect is about to escape, a helpful citizen steps forward to assist. However, as soon as the rookie officer pulls out his taser, it gets kicked away by the suspect. In his panic, he retrieves the taser but with shaking hands, he accidentally aims it at the good Samaritan who came to help. The helpful citizen, shocked by the electric jolt, thinks to himself that this officer is unreliable, so he uses all his strength to take down the suspect. At this moment, the rookie officer fails to seize the opportunity to immediately handcuff the suspect, instead fumbling with his radio to call for backup, only to find that the radio is broken. The suspect and the helpful citizen are locked in fierce combat, with the suspect using the dirty trick of eye-gouging to turn the situation around again. Yet the officer continues to fiddle with the radio, leaving the helpful citizen to struggle alone with the suspect. Fortunately, a passing woman reminds him to bring the handcuffs over. Only then does he pick up the handcuffs that had fallen on the ground, but the rookie officer tries three to five times without success to handcuff the suspect. This operation directly infuriates the helpful citizen, who quickly says "let me do it." Finally, through the protagonist's efforts, the suspect is subdued. However, the officer then insists on continuing to fiddle with the broken radio to call for backup. The helpful citizen kindly reminds him that the police car has a backup radio he could try. This turns out to be the rookie officer's greatest contribution to the incident. After calling for backup and getting out of the car, he sees the suspect still struggling like a pig being slaughtered, and once again doesn't know what to do. Just as the scene is about to spiral out of control, another passing elderly man can't stand watching anymore and steps forward to firmly hold down the suspect's flailing legs. At this point, the rookie officer hastily says he'll handle it, after all, he's the regular force and they're just providing support. Three minutes later, multiple officers arrive at the scene and finally gain complete control of the suspect. By now, the helpful citizen is already leaning against a mountain backdrop, sitting on a bench with a dissatisfied expression, exposing his shoulder to cool down, and openly expressing doubts to surrounding colleagues about the rookie officer's professional competence. A colleague immediately looks over with a surprised expression, because this helpful citizen's identity is no simple matter - he is the local police chief. The rookie officer realizes that not only did he bungle operations right under the chief's nose, but he also let the chief fight the suspect alone, and even tasered the old man. Thinking of this, he immediately breaks out in a cold sweat. The chief, due to the struggle with the suspect, suffered scraped knees and feet, and his left eye was gouged and swollen red, requiring emergency hospital treatment. The rookie officer's name is Joshua, and at the time of the incident, he had just finished his probationary period and was allowed to patrol alone for the first time that month. Unfortunately, this battle cost him his reputation, so he voluntarily resigned and soon changed careers to become a car salesman.; actions: type: watch, play_duration: 1, played_loop_cnt: 0, is_complete_play: False, is_fast_forward_play: False, is_backward_play: False, is_enlarge_play: False

Fu Lin seemed to have thought of something and laughed gleefully with schadenfreude, "So you plagiarized! How shameless." With ecological improvement, wild boar overpopulation has become a serious ecological and social problem in our country. In 2023, the state removed wild boars from the "Three Have" protected animal list. Under government supervision, having civilian farm protection teams control wild boar populations has become an effective method to manage wild boar damage. I'm Wu Zhiqiang. Because I love martial arts novels, I named the farm protection team "Northwest Swordsmen." I'm Dong Chunyu. Old Wu and I became friends through our shared love of dogs and formed the farm protection team together. Licensed farm protection—professional actions, do not imitate. We've now handed it over to locals for harmless disposal. Mainly because wild boars carry bacteria, so they can't be eaten. They're not quarantined or vaccinated either. Now over ten dogs have fallen ill. Without timely treatment, it can lead to canine distemper. We've already sent the serious cases to the pet hospital; we're handling the rest at home. So far we've spent over a hundred thousand on treatment. One particularly severe case cost seventy to eighty thousand to cure, but it can never go up the mountain again. After isolation, the Northwest Swordsmen Farm Protection Team specially brought in an experienced veterinary team from outside to conduct centralized quarantine and treatment for the hunting dogs, and purchased large quantities of medical supplies, doing everything possible to save the sick dogs. Why treat them? That's also a life. Now that you have the means, you must treat them. You can't just watch them die. I'd rather they die fighting on the mountain than die of illness. I didn't love dogs that much as a child, but after my mother passed away, dogs kept me company. Later in 2017, a very good friend of mine swindled away the savings I'd worked hard to accumulate over more than ten years, and my shop couldn't stay open anymore. After that I got dogs and spent a lot of time with them. Back then I felt that people would betray you, even your best friends, but dogs wouldn't. Later I stopped dealing with the outside world. name: "The highway emergency lane is not for people's emergencies" #CarKnowledge
description: type: Video Browsing; caption: "The highway emergency lane is not for people's emergencies" #CarKnowledge; ocr: Fixed camera filming, do not imitate. Actual circumstances shall prevail. The highway emergency lane, to put it bluntly, is not for people's personal emergencies. Someone in the car urgently needing to use the restroom or being tired and wanting to rest does not qualify as an emergency situation - these are all illegal occupations of the emergency lane. Let me put it this way: even if your stomach hurts so much you're spinning in circles, according to the rules you have to tough it out until the service area. So some people wonder, what if you really can't hold it? Actually, aside from human issues, if there's a problem with the vehicle and it really cannot continue driving safely, then you can stop in the emergency lane. At this point, you pop open the hood, place the warning triangle 150 meters behind the car, then people in the car go outside the guardrail to take care of urgent needs or rest a bit - generally the traffic police won't say much. Even if they come over to ask, just say the water temperature is too high and you need to stop to let it cool down. Having a different person drive when you get back in the car is also acceptable.; asr: The highway emergency lane, to put it bluntly, isn't for people's "emergencies" - like when someone in the car is tired and wants to stop at any exit, or wants to rest while looking at the moon. None of these count as emergency situations; they all constitute illegal occupation of the emergency lane. Put it this way: even if your stomach hurts so bad you're doubled over, according to the rules you have to tough it out until you reach a service area. So some people wonder, what if you really can't hold it? Actually, aside from human issues, if there's a problem with the vehicle and you truly cannot continue driving safely, then you can stop in the emergency lane. In that case, pop open the hood, place the warning triangle 150 meters behind the car, then have the passengers go outside the guardrail to take care of urgent needs or rest for a bit. Generally, the traffic police won't say much. Even if they come over to ask, just say the engine temperature is too high and you need to stop to let it cool down. It's also acceptable to have a different person drive when you get back in the car.; actions: type: watch, play_duration: 6, played_loop_cnt: 0, is_complete_play: False, is_fast_forward_play: False, is_backward_play: False, is_enlarge_play: False

Why do students like him so much? Study hard. Even I, the daughter of a high-ranking official, can't compare. Jealousy grows in my heart. Today's open class is Teacher Shuihen's only chance for permanent employment. Looking at the education bureau leaders in the audience, students who usually love asking tricky questions deliberately try to embarrass him. Why doesn't the monument use "zhuli" or "yili"? This kind of detailed question is more than enough to stump a high school student. Let's see what you do. Teacher Shuihen on stage froze, standing there somewhat awkwardly. Student Jidi, that's a good question. I can't give you a precise answer right now. Can I answer you tomorrow? As expected, he can't answer. Now it's done - he's lost face in front of the leaders. His chance for permanent employment is definitely ruined. Nothing matters, I'm satisfied. I'll wait for the mountain to come to me. No playing ball or other activities at school. Red flower evaluation board, Group 1, Group 2, Group 3, Group 4. The principal looks at the student I manipulated. And I watch Shuihen trying hard to maintain composure and continue teaching, the secret delight in my heart almost overflowing. He's deeply blaming himself for his sixth failed attempt at permanent employment. Serves him right, this is far from enough. I went straight to the leaders to complain with embellishments. These teachers have all developed tough skills - look, some even know how to raise pigs. Yudao Elementary School, directed by Lu Yeshang! Let's see who can protect you this time. I'll make sure you have no chance to turn things around. The leaders seriously said they would handle it. Why am I so bold? Because my father is the director of the education bureau. That's my confidence. Walking back to campus in a good mood, I heard several children chattering and discussing. Teacher Yanling is better than Teacher Shuihen, kids reciting scriptures are just better. My mom says Teacher Yanling is a college graduate, Teacher Shuihen is a high school graduate, college graduates are just better than high school graduates. Listen, even children know college graduates are better than high school graduates. Especially the sense of superiority compared to Shuihen, it's so sweet. Teacher He Yanling's tomb. But this elation didn't last more than a few seconds. I glanced over and they actually built a tomb for me. These little brats dare to curse me, definitely venting for Shuihen. How hateful! I kicked the dirt pile apart, trembling with anger, but completely helpless against these students. Why am I, a top graduate from a prestigious normal university, so unwelcome here? What magic does that Teacher Shuihen have? This question stuck in my heart like a thorn. I'm Yanling, graduated from Normal University. My boyfriend Li Shuang is equally excellent. We both looked forward to being assigned to work at the best No. 1 High School in the city - this was our natural starting point. But Li Shuang was worried. He came from a poor family with no connections, while my father is the director of the education bureau. Assigning who goes to No. 1 High School is just a matter of one sentence. Li Shuang hinted that he hoped we could work at the same school. Of course I understood what he meant - he wanted me to put in a good word with my father. No problem. My dad said they're deciding the assignment list at the education bureau today. Great! This small matter is nothing. I readily agreed. Father knew about my relationship with Li Shuang and sneered at his background. To break us up, he deliberately transferred him to a remote island. He's a top student. To ensure key middle schools... well, islands need good teachers too, right? So let him go to the island. When I learned this news, I felt it was unfair. I angrily argued with my father, saying wherever Li Shuang goes, I go too. We absolutely cannot be separated. But he put on a stern face and spoke in official tones: This is an organizational assignment, it's not up to you. Oh, you don't need to use official tones. They just want me to find someone of equal social status. But I wasn't willing to give up. For Li Shuang, I directly approached my father's good friend, Secretary Chang, and volunteered to teach on Xiaoyun Island. If you won't help me, I'll create my own opportunity to be together. Secretary Chang greatly appreciated this cadre's daughter voluntarily going to the grassroots, and promised to persuade my father. I was overjoyed. With Secretary Chang speaking up, father had to listen. Thank you, Uncle Chang. I never expected that father was more cunning than I imagined and pulled the cruelest move. He tampered with our assignment notices. Let Yanling go to the island for training. Puquan City Education Bureau. Just like that, we each achieved our respective wish

It directly points to the warlike instinct in human nature.; asr: What exactly did this woman experience that left her desperately struggling next to a corpse with her mouth full of unknown liquid, when just moments ago she had been leisurely eating crayfish? She was watching the entire alarm after the German army occupied a Soviet village. The German soldiers carried a paralyzed old woman into the square and made her watch as everyone was slaughtered. Then the Germans herded all the villagers into wooden houses and sealed them shut. An old man who tried to look outside was immediately shot dead by the Germans. A desperate mother pushed her young child out the window, only to have the Germans throw the child back in. A girl who managed to escape was dragged by her hair for dozens of meters before being thrown into a truck full of soldiers. Finally, amid the girl's miserable screams, the Germans threw grenades and Molotov cocktails into each wooden house one by one until all the houses were set ablaze. The German officers applauded in a demonic manner, enjoying the bonfire feast brought by this massacre. In just a few minutes, hundreds of lives turned to ashes. Witnessing everything, the boy trembled uncontrollably with rage. The Germans dragged the boy to an open space, made him kneel on the ground like a dog, and pressed a gun to his head. The boy was terrified and at a loss. Fortunately, the Germans didn't kill him but instead took commemorative photos with him as a war trophy. In an instant, the boy was overwhelmed by fear and despair, ravaged by war into what looked like an aged old man. Yet just days before, he had been an earnest young man eagerly anticipating the battlefield. To join the fight, he and his friends kept digging through ruins, and after great effort, he finally found a gun. Hurrah! With joy, he now had a gun and could join the Soviet partisans. But when his mother learned of his decision, she handed him an axe and told him to kill her and his twin sister first. But Flyora didn't take it seriously and made a face at his sister. Seeing her son didn't understand, and not knowing whether her husband was alive or dead, the mother angrily grabbed a rope and kept whipping Flyora. But what had to come still came. The next day, Flyora was already prepared. Gun in one hand and suitcase in the other, he happily went off to be a soldier, completely unaware that this goodbye might be forever. After joining the partisans, Flyora didn't get to participate in combat as he wished but was left behind with the old, young, sick, and disabled. Looking at the wounded soldiers and elderly behind him, Flyora angrily turned and left, attempting to secretly follow the troops to the front lines. But then he encountered a crying girl. Flyora successfully made the girl laugh with his comical performance, and the two became friends. Just then, German aircraft suddenly roared overhead, bombing the partisan camp to pieces. The massive shockwave left Flyora's ears ringing and bleeding. He stood there dazed and at a loss, watching as German paratroopers began landing one after another. The girl pulled Flyora to flee quickly. When they escaped back to the village, it was eerily quiet. Flyora's home was also empty and in disarray. Looking at the already dirt-stained items on the ground, Flyora immediately sensed something was wrong. But he thought they were just hiding in the more concealed forest. However, when they struggled across the swamp and successfully reached the temporary shelter, Flyora was completely devastated. He pushed through the crowded people and saw the village chief, already burned black. The chief, barely breathing, blamed Flyora for digging up the gun, saying it was because of this that his family and villagers had been killed. After learning the truth, Flyora was in agony. The intense sense of guilt made him unwilling to face reality. In pain, he buried his head in the swamp, wanting to briefly escape reality. Due to food shortage at the shelter, three villagers wanted to borrow the boy's gun to search for food, but the boy decided to go to a warehouse in a nearby village to look for food himself. They inserted scarecrows made of straw by the roadside to attract German attention, then quickly ran toward the warehouse. But the next second, two villagers stepped on enemy landmines. With a huge explosion, the two were blown apart. Following the middle of the road to the warehouse, the two soon arrived at a German-occupied village and snatched a cow from Soviet hands. Hello, parent. I'm from the gate. We just went out to check at the third master's gate. We caught the persimmon soldiers. They said it was you. Your company said you were their leader. We have to start from the beginning. Several new recruits had just finished eating at the cafeteria. Everything looked fresh to them, and they walked leisurely, completely feeling like they were strolling on the street. They didn't go directly to where the company commander was, which is why they ran right into the patrol soldiers. "I can't confirm your identities now. Please come back to the gate with me.
