But in the eyes of someone who has served, there were problems everywhere, especially when the company commander fired his gun - that reaction speed was something else. "Yes, just like that, just like that, just like this marriage, just like that. Go, walk this way, yes." These movements almost made the company commander hungry watching them. But then again, whether the movements were standard or not aside, at least their spirit and determination were really something, especially the crawling forward - no need to say more. Just looking at that posture, it was like a fierce tiger descending the mountain, unstoppable. Of course, the details might still need time to polish, but the company commander liked this kind of momentum. At least for now, no one was slacking off. They displayed the soldier's never-give-up spirit quite perfectly. What do you think? "Help him up, hold the money, help him up, don't get up yet, get up, get up, get up."

In the dormitory, what gave these new soldiers the biggest headache was folding quilts. When they were at home, folding quilts was quite casual - fold however you want, and even if you don't fold it, that's completely fine. But here, sorry, that's not how it works. You not only have to fold it well, but it has to have sharp corners like a block of tofu. This stumped these new recruits because they had never done this at home. They couldn't help but sigh - they never thought folding a quilt could be so difficult. "I've never seen such a neat quilt. I need to salute it. I salute it. You've never folded a quilt in your life, have you? You've never folded such a neat quilt. Don't delete the truth beside me. This is what I folded with my own hands. It's not easy."

Since the quilts were organized, without further ado, it was time to start training again. Only this time, the training both excited them and made them feel uncertain. Why? Five-year-old Zhuang Anqi first entered the public eye standing quietly by the street holding a stick. At that time, an Yingge dance parade was passing by with exaggerated makeup and thunderous drums and gongs. Most children might have been scared, but he was ignited in an instant. He didn't shy away; instead, he confidently followed the rhythm, swinging his stick and dancing as if there were already marks in his bloodline. From that moment on, Zhuang Anqi became completely captivated by Yingge dance. He practiced at home every day and formally apprenticed himself to learn the art. His small hands were repeatedly worn and calloused. His mother said he should stop dancing Yingge, but he replied with unwavering determination despite being only five years old. With exceptional talent, he quickly became the core of the troupe. Whether in regular training or external performances, he steadily held the center position. Later, he even performed on the Spring Festival Gala stage, making his name known to audiences nationwide. Equally moving is a scene from lion dance inheritance: a grandfather teaching a child lion dance, starting with low-difficulty moves. After the child successfully completed them, the grandfather quietly increased the difficulty. Unexpectedly, the child completed it again. The grandfather's delighted and proud expression seemed to say, "See, this is a child from my sect." In 2024 in Jieyang, Guangdong, seven-year-old Lin Xinyue was practicing lion dance at her doorstep when she happened to encounter a professional lion dance team waiting at a red light. A man woke up one day and suddenly gained the ability to divine and predict. But how could it rain when the sky was bright and sunny? Just as he was about to go out with an umbrella, his wife happened to see him. "Hey, are you crazy? What are you doing on such a sunny day?" The man told his wife decisively, "Just wait. It's going to rain soon." With that, he left without looking back. As soon as he reached the village entrance, he ran into his neighbor. "What's wrong with you? Why are you carrying an umbrella on such a sunny day?" "Hehe, nothing's wrong. It's sunny now, but it'll rain soon." Hearing this, both were incredulous. Could this Huang Hama have some strange illness? But soon something miraculous happened. Dark clouds covered the sky and heavy rain poured down. The neighbors who had just mocked him all rushed under Huang Hama's umbrella to take shelter. "How did you know?" "I can predict things." "You have this ability? You're like Zhuge Liang!" Although Huang Hama couldn't actually tell fortunes, since people came to him, he couldn't lose face. He pretended to calculate and actually came up with an answer. "I've figured it out. Yang San'er will definitely return home by the end of next month." "Really?" Zhang Ma, standing nearby, saw his reputation was well-deserved and quickly asked him to divine for her too about her lost earring. "Your earring isn't lost. It's at your home, next to the stove, under the water vat. You'll find it right away." Zhang Ma thanked him repeatedly and hurried home to find her earring. As soon as Zhang Ma left, his wife complained. "You're talking nonsense!" But Huang Hama looked confident. His answer wasn't made up out of thin air. "Yang San's wife is due to give birth at the end of next month, right?" His wife immediately understood. It turned out Huang Hama had overheard their family chat in the inner room. Yang's wife was due at the end of next month. Wouldn't Yang San, as the father, come back in person? As for Zhang Ma's earring, housewives spend all day around the stove and water vat—where else could it be lost? Just then, Zhang Ma came running back with her earring. Following Huang Hama's words, she had indeed found the earring under the water vat. But Huang Hama didn't know this act would nearly cost him his head.

A month ago, the Emperor's luminous pearl had gone missing, and he sent the Chief Eunuch to find someone among the common people to help. Logically, they should find someone accurate and experienced, but the Chief didn't follow convention. "Are you accurate?" "I'm Liu Tiezui. Every divination I do here is accurate!" "I won't choose you." Several others all claimed they were accurate. Just then, Zhang Ma heard an official was looking for a living immortal and recommended her neighbor Huang Hama. "Huang Banxian—that's the nickname they gave me. My surname is Huang." "We're looking for a diviner. Are you accurate?" "Very!" "Don't listen to his nonsense. I'm not accurate at all, really not!" "Good, let me tell you. A luminous pearl was lost in the palace. The Emperor has chosen you to divine. Come with me." Huang Hama was dumbfounded. The Chief wasn't following the usual path. This could cost him his head. He quickly stopped the Chief, repeatedly emphasizing his divination wasn't accurate, but the Chief knew he wasn't accurate—if he were, why would he want him? "My divination is accurate!" "How accurate?" "Sir, it will rain soon." "Oh, with that kind of accuracy, you must come. Let's go."

Although Huang Hama was extremely unwilling, under the Chief's coercion, he had no choice but to steel himself and follow. "If I don't come home tomorrow, tell your aunt to light the firewood in the backyard the morning after." "Why?" "Just do as I say." Since it was late, the Chief stayed at an inn. description: type: Video Browsing; caption: Hospital department makes too much money, gets directly shut down #QuickTalk #HospitalRevolution; ocr: Why does Renault perform the fewest surgeries in the entire department? The side effect of this medication is insomnia.; asr: On her first day at the hospital, she directly fired all the doctors in the cardiac surgery department, and the reason given was that this department made too much money. Just when everyone thought she had medical care questions, you hope the hospital can... A doctor boldly raised his hand, hoping the hospital would eliminate the waiting room so patients could go directly to hospital beds. This was an almost impossible problem to solve. Unexpectedly, he agreed directly, and to solve the problem of insufficient doctors, he made all department heads raise their hands, requiring them to start seeing patients personally from that moment on. Those who disagreed could resign directly. He even waved his hand grandly, wanting to recruit 50 attending physicians. He wanted to let patients have their... let doctors return to being doctors, to thoroughly reform this institution that prioritizes profit. After the meeting ended, Max went to the cardiac surgery department he had just decimated and found Reynolds, who was packing up to leave. Max didn't understand why Reynolds performed the fewest surgeries in the entire department for patients. Reynolds told him that surgery isn't the only way to save people - he just gave patients the highest quality and most affordable treatment plan. Because of this statement, he was rehired by Max and promoted to director of cardiac surgery. As he was leaving, Reynolds reminded him that the medical system had been completely manipulated and wouldn't... Max told him that before they discovered it, he would help as many people as possible. Max was very busy, appearing wherever doctors encountered problems, shuttling back and forth between departments asking doctors the same question... A special case came up, and he happened to run into the patient's attending physician, Puer. After learning he temporarily didn't need the hospital's help, Max left. But the patient's family became anxious - the doctor in front of them didn't know... and began to doubt the doctor's ability. The doctor even asked him to come to the office, saying he wanted to have a good chat with him. The family was speechless - it was clearly the wife in the hospital bed who had Parkinson's. After finally waiting for the wife to wake up, the doctor didn't prescribe medication but instead ordered all kinds of tests. The family finally couldn't sit still - the wife had been diagnosed with Parkinson's for a long time, and they hoped the doctor would prescribe medication as soon as possible to relieve her pain. Unexpectedly, the doctor still refused and even asked him to continue chatting in the office. This time... Even the doctor's assistant thought the doctor might kill the patient, so they told Max about the situation. When Max arrived, he learned there was more to the patient's condition. Based on conversations with the family and further examination, the patient might have been misdiagnosed two years ago with depression. At that time, the doctor prescribed her folic acid, which caused cardiac rigidity. When she went to the hospital, the doctor thought it was Parkinson's and prescribed levodopa. This medication, combined with Ativan - when these two drugs are taken together, they produce a toxin, which is the cause of the patient's current condition. What had never been detected in her body was a malignant tumor. If they continued treating it as Parkinson's, the patient might die immediately. They found the patient and told her she was critically ill, leaving the next choice to the patient. The husband suggested his wife stay in the hospital, believing her condition would improve. But the wife refused. She knew her days were numbered - rather than endure painful treatment in the hospital, she'd rather go home to do what she wanted and spend time with people she wanted to see. Now the only problem was that they had illegally crossed the border from Mexico - they would be arrested as soon as they crossed back. Max immediately found the Mexican ambassador who was about to be discharged and requested that he repatriate the couple. This allowed them to return to Mexico smoothly and fulfill their wish to reunite with their family. A Lamborghini runs a red light, and the traffic cop chases it on a bicycle, pedaling so hard the wheels are practically smoking before catching up. Netizens wonder why they don't use motorcycles. Actually, Japanese police did use motorcycles for enforcement in the early days, but Japan has many old buildings with wooden structures and poor soundproofing. So what if American police are tough? After getting hit by someone, they still have to open the door for him, put on a smile, and help him into the car. This old man was already 83 years old at the time of the incident. His name was William Wackley, known in the streets as Wild Bill. On June 26, 2024, Perry Township in Ohio received a police report saying someone had cut their grass short without permission. Good grief, in this day and age, there are people who voluntarily help cut grass for free and then get reported for it. But the caller didn't mention that the grass cutter was William, so the responding officers didn't know they were looking for Wild Bill. On their way to the scene, the patrol officers spotted a lawnmower that matched the dispatch center's description. Plus, he wasn't on the right road and was going too slow, suspected of obstructing traffic. The patrol car blocked him from the front and chased from behind, but William didn't give a damn about them. With a left turn, he crossed the double yellow line into the oncoming lane, skillfully bypassing the patrol car ahead. It's just a small lawnmower - they couldn't exactly ram into it. Anyway, this thing can't go fast, so the officers slowly followed to see what he was up to. They turned on the siren and honked to alert him - surely he'd know they were calling for him. But William just waved his hand, as if to say "you go ahead and pass," acting like it had nothing to do with him. Seeing another police car coming from ahead, William made a left turn into someone's yard. The officer was confident he couldn't escape, so he accelerated forward to coordinate with his teammate to surround and block him. Actually, I'm puzzled too - in such a wide-open area, why didn't they just chase directly and cut him off from the front? Why make such a big circle? If they were worried about driving on someone's private lawn, well, they ended up doing that anyway when they came around. William drove the lawnmower from one yard to another, so casually, as if the whole area was his own yard. The officer floored it and circled around - at least he didn't have to pay for gas. The area was too large, and with all the twists and turns, two patrol cars simply couldn't block him. The officer decided to get out and chase on foot. After all, a lawnmower can't go that fast. The officer shouted at William, and William glanced over so nonchalantly. The officer directly fired his Taser gun, but William's jacket was too loose and baggy. The Taser probes couldn't penetrate at all. Actually, the officer had already recognized William at this point, but the current situation wasn't suitable for a friendly chat. William was too famous - everyone in the police station from the chief down to the janitor knew him. Running until their legs were worn thin, they finally caught up with William. William was hiding under some bushes, hugging the edge for cover. Seeing the officer, he tried to run again. The officer rushed up and grabbed the lawnmower. Don't underestimate William's age - he's a master at operating a lawnmower and wasn't flustered at all, slowly backing up. But William still had a trick up his sleeve. With a sharp turn, he plunged into the bushes. Not a single officer took the opportunity to rush forward. The Taser gun in hand wasn't fired either, just chasing William forward. William pulled off a 180-degree turn on the grass. No one could get close. Although the Taser was fired again, it was still blocked by William's oversized jacket and didn't cause any injury. It was obvious the officers weren't being ruthless. There wasn't even a hint of tension throughout the whole process - their communication was all cordial. A caring official for the people, reeking of alcohol, she walked out the door, only to be corrupted by capital and power, gaining trust. The wind howled fiercely, crying herself hoarse. The villagers feared getting into trouble. Between Lin Hui and Jiang Zicheng, while Lin Hui mistakenly married Old Tang, her temper became increasingly volatile. This outwardly upright official, along with photos of Jiang Zicheng and Ayun. After that night, smiling triumphantly, ultimately became the coldest mastermind who crushed everyone.; asr: Some say the greatest evil lies not in the darkness of night, but in those who wear a veneer of respectability. By day he was an honest and upright official who cared for the people, a parental figure to the masses, but at night he put on another face and became a depraved demon who amassed sudden wealth. Such a contrast was chilling, yet this two-faced man was none other than Tang, the director of Guangzhou's Urban Construction Committee. By day he was busy allocating land and approving buildings, putting on an appearance of working tirelessly for the people. At night he transformed into a nightclub regular, and his perversions were even more outrageous—for every project he approved, he had to review people at nightclubs. What he wanted wasn't documents, but women. That day, a development group invited him to dinner and sent the company president's wife to pour drinks—a charming and dignified young married woman. In the private room, the lighting was suggestive and the air thick with alcohol. The moment Tang saw this woman, his eyes lit up. The others tactfully withdrew, leaving the two alone. Tang spoke with a smile, his tone threatening—as long as she could make him happy, the project would be approved immediately. But not only did the woman refuse to flatter him, she pushed him away. Tang's face turned ashen on the spot. He had never been defied like this. Ever since taking the director's position, he had grown accustomed to others bowing and scraping before him. The woman picked up the contract from the floor and walked out without looking back. Little did she know that outside the door, cold eyes were watching this private room. Two minutes later, the woman left the nightclub in a flustered state, her cheeks flushed and eyes evasive. As she walked out, she seemed to see a figure flash at the end of the corridor. At that moment, an inexplicable unease welled up inside her. A few days later, she mysteriously disappeared, and at almost the same time, Tang was found dead in an unfinished building in an urban village. The dignified construction director died under bizarre circumstances, his body impaled on steel reinforcement bars, seemingly deliberately positioned. When the news broke, the entire city exploded. Some said it was an accident, others said it was retribution—after all, he held too many secrets and had offended too many people. The incident occurred in an urban village by the Jiangbei River in Tianhe District, Guangzhou. The area was undergoing old city renovation, originally a project to benefit the people, but it had been corrupted by capital and power. The unfair distribution of relocation compensation had villagers furious. The developers, backed by powerful connections, sent thugs to force relocations, and violent conflicts escalated. That evening, police sirens wailed and the scene was as chaotic as a battlefield. Tang, as the head of the supervising authority, personally rushed to the scene. Claiming to serve the people, he took a megaphone to pacify the villagers, saying things like "trust the government, believe in policy," but the villagers, long oppressed and disheartened, weren't buying it. Someone threw stones and bottles at him, nearly hitting his head. Seeing the situation spiraling out of control, Tang changed his approach, pretending to be moved and saying he would lead by example and demolish his own house to gain trust. As he finished speaking, the crowd's clamor seemed to die down a bit. Night fell and the situation was temporarily calmed. When reporters arrived at the scene and pointed cameras at Tang, he immediately put on that concerned expression, his mouth full of talk about lawful demolition and improving people's livelihoods. But as soon as he turned around, the smile vanished from his face. After the interview, he took his assistant to visit a holdout household. The family made it clear: no money, no move. Tang patiently put on a show, offered a few comforting words, then coldly instructed his assistant to take photos for the record. description: type: Video Browsing; caption: SWAT team raids wrong address, 68-year-old grandmother endures two flashbangs and goes blind #American police enforcement; ocr: Leading to blindness in both eyes. SWAT team raids residence at wrong address. 68-year-old grandmother endures two flashbangs, police relentlessly pursue. Police department has search warrant, is anyone there? This somewhat makes up for this sudden terrible experience.; asr: SWAT team raids residence but gets the wrong address, breaking down the door directly. "I'm breaching, I'm breaching, starting to breach." A 68-year-old grandmother endures two flashbangs, causing temporary blindness in both eyes. So how will this blunder ultimately be resolved? Hello everyone, this incident occurred in Vanderburgh County, Indiana. The local SWAT team received an urgent mission that day. Someone had posted a bounty online, openly threatening to attack the police station and assassinate the chief. Once the news broke, the police department traced the IP address to locate where it was posted. To prevent any mishap, the chief directly deployed the SWAT team, planning to preemptively apprehend the person who made the post. From the footage, you can see SWAT members breaking down the door and throwing in a flashbang. The team members instinctively turned away to avoid the bright light, but the grandmother who was about to answer the door was hit by the flashbang and could barely open her eyes. The team members covered each other while quickly rushing into the room, but there was no dangerous person as imagined inside—only a young girl watching TV and her grandmother. "Upon you know I'm tappy your hand, but just it's a tappy I'm got it." However, the SWAT team didn't let their guard down because of the girl's young age and still chose to handcuff her. After all, in their view, screening for criminals doesn't discriminate by age. After securing the girl, police began searching every corner of the room—from the medicine cabinet in the shower to the bedroom to the closet upstairs—checking all possible hiding places but never finding any evidence linking the grandmother and granddaughter to the case. At this point, a group of officers reached the basement door and faintly heard movement inside. The officers speculated that the suspect they were looking for might be hiding in there. "Who are you?" In the end, the officers only found a cat curled up in fear in the dark basement. With no other option, they had to return upstairs to explain the current situation to the girl's grandmother. "Don't for man to means in it." At this point, the young officer had clearly sensed the awkwardness of the scene, but the SWAT captain still patiently recounted the entire incident to the 68-year-old woman. The elderly woman expressed her grievance, saying she was just spending the weekend at home with her granddaughter when SWAT suddenly broke down the door, and she took two flashbangs head-on. What's more upsetting is that the grandmother and granddaughter had never posted any threatening statements online, and only had a basic phone that could only make calls, with no capability to post information online. The subsequent investigation revealed that a strange man had hijacked the elderly woman's wireless network and posted that bounty. Police quickly arrested the man and filed federal charges against him. The responsibility for the property damage caused by the SWAT operation and the psychological trauma inflicted on the grandmother and granddaughter fell on the local police department. Eventually, the family reached a settlement with the city and received $160,000 in compensation. Presumably, this money should be enough to replace a new glass door and somewhat compensate for the sudden terrible experience the grandmother and granddaughter endured.; actions: type: watch, play_duration: 111, played_loop_cnt: 0, is_complete_play: False, is_fast_forward_play: True, is_backward_play: False, is_enlarge_play: False

name: American couple's first visit to Chengdu, almost dined and dashed! #TravelVLOG #
description: type: Video Browsing; caption: American couple's first visit to Chengdu, almost dined and dashed! #TravelVLOG #TravelDocumentary #ForeignersInChina #DocumentaryNarration; ocr: An American couple arrived in China for the first time. Their first meal in Chengdu was at a small restaurant whose payment scanner only accepted UnionPay cards. The staff had already brought out steaming hot wontons and proactively told Mike where to find a nearby ATM. The cash withdrawal process was also full of twists and turns, but just when he was at his wit's end, staff from the People's Bank of China helped him. After Mike returned, he had no time to worry about the exhaustion from running around. One dish was Chengdu's specialty red oil wontons, whose unique numbing spiciness was incredibly satisfying. Seeing them eat one after another with their chopsticks, the proprietress soon added another serving. Although Chengdu's winter was cold, their faces were filled with anticipation for the city. Customs and baggage claim took only 5 minutes. Long-distance buses, high-speed rail, metro, and moving walkways allowed them to communicate smoothly with staff. After finally finding the metro station, Line 2 made it easy to scan in with a mobile app, which was much more convenient than having cash. From Tianfu Airport Terminals 1 and 2, they took Line 18 toward Chenan Station, with Futian as the next stop. Exiting the metro station, they walked while observing Chengdu's street scenes, even spotting cute raincoats for electric scooters. They also discussed video recording equipment, saying iPhone file transfers were troublesome. This meant they could return countless times in the future. They quickly found their booked hotel, less than $200 for a week. The rooms were arranged with no logic, but had a separate vanity area and workspace with everything needed, completely outclassing rooms with cigarette smell. This undoubtedly got their Chengdu trip off to a good start.; actions: type: watch, play_duration: 3, played_loop_cnt: 0, is_complete_play: False, is_fast_forward_play: False, is_backward_play: False, is_enlarge_play: False

The entire procedure is fast and efficient.; asr: Watching Germans replace manhole covers, the entire process is dominated by a single machine with astonishingly high operational efficiency. They generally use machinery to move anything over 30 kilograms, as manual handling is considered somewhat costly. The machine first attaches a curved hook, then heavily marks lines around the manhole cover to enclose it, and directly pries up the concrete blocks. The entire process requires no manual assistance whatsoever; workers only need to observe from the side and step in when necessary. The machine then quickly stacks the pried-up concrete blocks to one side. Once ready, it firmly grips the old manhole cover and removes it. Only then do the nearby workers step forward to slowly shovel away the soil that wasn't properly handled. Subsequently, the machine lifts the new manhole cover from the vehicle and precisely places it on the opening to complete the replacement. After the replacement is done, the machine switches to a shovel attachment to scoop the concrete debris from the ground into one place, then fills the surrounding soil next to the manhole cover. The entire sequence is completed very quickly. Emergency rescue supply vehicles are coordinating with highway authorities.; asr: Giant of Guilin Hu Lei rushed aid to disaster area but was charged 1,180 yuan in tolls, afterwards politely declined local leaders' offer to pool money for reimbursement. Recently, philanthropist Hu Lei drove to deliver 90,000 yuan worth of daily necessities to the Baise disaster area in Guangxi affected by typhoons, and was charged 1,180 yuan in tolls at the Debao toll station exit. Hu Lei raised questions, stating that in previous donations to other disaster areas, advance registration allowed free passage, and emphasized that he was not seeking to recover the 1,000-plus yuan. As the incident drew attention, the deputy director of Debao County Civil Affairs Bureau and several cadres voluntarily pooled money to reimburse him, but were all politely declined by Hu Lei. The Guangxi Expressway Operating Company responded that according to regulations, emergency relief supply vehicles must present certification issued by county-level or higher government or transportation authorities to pass toll-free. If certification could not be provided at the time, a refund application could also be submitted afterwards. description:
type: Video Browsing; caption: #HistoricalStories #PreciousHistoricalFootage #CherishPeace; ocr: In 1945, the moment a Nazi woman was executed. Her name was Irma Grese Becker. Between 1939 and 1944, her humanity gradually eroded. According to United Nations war criminal records, Becker's actions during what should have been the bloom of her youth pushed her into the abyss due to her environment.; asr: A 1945 photograph of a Nazi female guard at the moment of her death. In the frame, she wears a short skirt with a full figure, but don't be deceived by her petite and beautiful appearance. In reality, she was a woman with a viper's heart. Her name was Irma Grese Becker, only 22 years old, yet at Stutthof concentration camp, she created a legend of hell. Opening those sealed archives, you'll discover she wasn't born a devil, but rather a product forged by the war machine. Think about it—how did a country girl end up on this path of no return?

According to historians, Becker was born in 1923 to an ordinary farming family in Lower Saxony, Germany. In her childhood, she was probably like any other girl—helping her parents with farm work, dreaming of wearing pretty dresses and going dancing. But in 1939, when Hitler's iron boots marched into Poland, everything changed. War drives people mad, especially those young people brainwashed by Nazi propaganda. After Becker joined the SS, she was assigned to Stutthof concentration camp, which held over 1,000 Jewish women and children. Her job was to oversee these prisoners, but in her hands, this became a carnival of brutality.

Don't think she was a cold-blooded monster—archives show she would sometimes pretend to be gentle, deceiving pregnant women into believing she would help them. The result? Their fate was often inhumane torture. For example, one survivor's memoir records that Becker once forced a group of Jewish women to stand in the bitter cold for hours simply because their gaze displeased her. That scene was like a reflection of hell—frail figures trembling in the snow while Becker stood aside, smoking a cigarette with a cold sneer on her lips.

Why did she do this? Psychologists who analyzed the Nuremberg trial documents after World War II noted that many Nazi guards like her were conditioned in a totalitarian environment where obedience and following orders became survival instincts, torture and killing became routine, and over time, humanity was ground away. But Becker wasn't simply an executor—she took pleasure in it. Historical records show she personally killed at least hundreds of people, including pregnant women and infants. Imagine—boots hidden beneath a short skirt, a whip in hand, eyes gleaming with pathological excitement.

Declassified Allied documents contain testimony describing one of her "performances": when a Jewish pregnant woman went into labor, she wouldn't let doctors intervene but handled it herself, resulting in the death of both mother and child. Reading this, doesn't your heart sink? Not because of the gore, but because of that anti-human twisted nature. Becker's behavior makes one ask: where is humanity? During her days at the camp, she appeared glorious on the surface, but it was actually a manifestation of inner emptiness. Survivor oral histories mention that she occasionally showed vulnerability, such as sitting alone in the guard room smoking late at night, but would immediately transform back into a demon. This contradiction is precisely the tragedy of war—it not only destroys bodies but corrodes souls.

After Germany's defeat, Becker was captured by the Allies. In April 1945, she was brought to trial. The trial process was brutal and swift. According to UN war criminal archives, she was charged with war crimes and crimes against humanity. In court, she tried to argue that she was only following orders, but the evidence was overwhelming—witnesses and documents piled up like mountains. Ultimately, she was sentenced to death by hanging, executed at only 22 years old.

Becker's story reminds me of Du Fu's verse: "The nation broken, mountains and rivers remain; spring in the city, grass and trees grow deep." Not a direct quote, but an adaptation—the nation shattered, vegetation still there, but people may have become deformed. Her 22 years should have been the bloom of youth, but withered in hatred.

Writing this, one can't help but wonder: if she hadn't encountered that era, would she have just been an ordinary girl? But history has no "what ifs," only lessons. Looking back, the Nazi system of World War II created countless tools like Becker. They weren't born evil but had their morality systematically destroyed. Data supports this view—according to the United States Holocaust Memorial Museum statistics, although women comprised a small percentage of Nazi concentration camp guards, their brutality was no less than men's. They often used domestic-style abuse as camouflage, and Becker was typical.

name: Why is there a wooden plank installed on the bottom of an F1 car chassis? #F1 #R
description: type: Video Browsing; caption: Why is there a wooden plank installed on the bottom of an F1 car chassis? #F1 #Racing #Science; ocr: Why do F1 car chassis have a wooden plank installed? Some teams, in pursuit of lower drag, had the plank wear exceed one millimeter, ultimately losing their achieved race results.; asr: Why is a wooden plank installed on F1 car chassis? This regulation originated from the death of racing legend Senna in an accident during a 1994 race. Previously, some teams would excessively lower the car chassis in pursuit of lower ride height, but an overly low chassis not only easily damages the vehicle's aerodynamics but could also cause the fuel tank to scrape against the ground, creating major safety hazards. To protect driver safety, race officials explicitly require that all F1 car chassis must be fitted with a one-centimeter-thick wooden plank, and if the plank wears down by more than one millimeter, the driver will be disqualified. For example, in the F1 Shanghai Grand Prix, Hamilton lost his race results due to excessive wear on his car's chassis plank.; actions: type: watch, play_duration: 2, played_loop_cnt: 0, is_complete_play: False, is_fast_forward_play: False, is_backward_play: False, is_enlarge_play: False

Police files: Footprints in the bedroom. More bloodstains appeared before the police officers' eyes. Detective Old Xu believes that the criminal suspect is the son of the deceased's fourth uncle.; asr: A 26-year-old woman was raped and murdered, her underwear and bra cut off with a dagger by the suspect. The suspect then stabbed the woman's chest seven times, causing her to die in agony from blood loss. When police investigated the case, they found the crime scene extremely complex. The suspect had attacked the woman with a dagger on the staircase, then dragged the injured victim into the bedroom, locked the door from inside, and raped and killed her. Most critically, after killing the victim, the suspect cleaned the crime scene before escaping through the window. Because of this cleaning, police found only two footprints and no other useful clues. What troubled police most was a small bloodstain on the staircase wall belonging to the suspect, suggesting the killer might escape legal punishment entirely. However, just when police thought they could only rely on DNA comparison, the results brought a shocking answer—the suspect was a direct blood relative of the victim.

On April 21, 2013, Old Man Huang from Jinping County, Qiandongnan Prefecture, Guizhou Province, went to his daughter's residence in the southern suburbs because she hadn't contacted him for several days. When he opened the door, an ominous feeling came over him—on the staircase leading to his daughter's third-floor bedroom, he discovered dried bloodstains. He hurried to the bedroom door and tried to open it, only to find it locked from inside. No matter how much he knocked and shouted, there was no response. With no other option, Old Man Huang went to the roof. Since he had built the house himself, he easily found some loose ceiling panels, pried them open, and prepared to go down from above.

At four o'clock in the afternoon, police received the report. When they arrived, he told them his daughter had been killed. Upon receiving the call from their superior, they immediately rushed to the scene. The superior instructed them to establish a pathway through the scene to prevent subsequent investigators from destroying trace evidence.

Following the staircase to the third-floor bedroom, police began carefully making their way forward. When they reached the second floor, dried bloodstains began to appear. What puzzled police was that Old Man Huang had clearly stated when reporting the case that his daughter died in the third-floor bedroom, so why were there bloodstains on the second-floor staircase? Moreover, as police climbed step by step, more bloodstains appeared. When they reached the third-floor bedroom door, the large amount of bloodstains shocked them.

Police then discovered an anomaly—there were numerous bloodstains on the staircase windows and walls, but none on the landing between the second and third floors. However, officers discovered traces of someone having cleaned the hallway with a mop. Who had cleaned these bloodstains? What had happened in the hallway? Police continued their investigation. When they reached the third-floor bedroom door, officers found it locked from inside. Since the door couldn't be opened with a key and police didn't want to force it open violently, which might destroy clues left by the suspect, they decided to enter through the bedroom roof as Old Man Huang had done. Soon, an officer entered through the pried-open ceiling panels and opened the bedroom door, allowing other officers to enter and conduct a more detailed investigation.

The body was lying on its right side, already in an advanced state of decomposition. Based on the timeline, it had been over seven days, between seven and ten days. There were five wounds on the back and one on the right side of the face. There was also an injury on the left forearm near the wrist joint, which appeared to be a defensive wound. The fatal wound was on the back, from the left side, where the blade penetrated the heart.

When police examined the victim's clothing, they suddenly discovered that the victim's undergarments had all been cut with a sharp object—both the bra and underwear had been cut open by the suspect. Police therefore suspected the suspect had likely raped the victim. Police were then surprised to find that aside from clues on the victim's body, very few useful clues were discovered at the crime scene, because officers found that just as the bloodstains in the hallway had been cleaned, the bloodstains at the crime scene had also been cleaned. Additionally, the suspect had wiped away all traces of their footprints and fingerprints.

description: type: Video Browsing; caption: You're keeping 1000 yuan to celebrate the New Year? #social_phenomena #life_reflections #trending; ocr: You want 1000 yuan, waiting for Chinese New Year? Just this. This one sentence caused the Adidas Nanchang Mixc store to completely crash and burn. It started in October when Ms. Guo spent 1,688 yuan at an Adidas store to buy a pair of running shoes. Before even leaving the mall, while eating hotpot, her child accidentally discovered the shoes had already split open. The large gap was clearly defective. She immediately went back to request a refund, but not only did the staff refuse, they also gave her cold looks, implying it was intentional damage. Even more outrageous, the store manager privately instructed employees to ignore her, hoping to drag it out until Ms. Guo left on her own. They even mocked her, saying she bought a pair of shoes for over 1000 yuan and acted like she bought a house worth a million, asking if she was waiting for this 1000 yuan to get through the New Year. These words weren't service—they were an insult to the consumer. Ms. Guo sensed something was wrong and decisively grabbed the employee's phone, discovering the chat records were full of messages like "stall her, don't give the refund." Ms. Guo immediately called 12315, summoned reporters and police. Only when the brand's touring manager arrived and reviewed the surveillance footage did they reluctantly apologize and issue a refund. That foul-mouthed store manager hid the entire time and never showed their face. This incident went viral not because of a pair of shoes, but because that one line "are you waiting for the money to get through the New Year" hit too many people's sore spots. 1000 yuan might not mean much to some people, but for ordinary families, that's real hard-earned money.; actions: type: watch, play_duration: 62, played_loop_cnt: 0, is_complete_play: False, is_fast_forward_play: False, is_backward_play: False, is_enlarge_play: False

description: type: Video Browsing; ocr: Li Linyu sacrificed his life to save others. His father took the initiative to repay his son's student loans to fulfill the promise his son made before his death. Excellent academic performance, always taking pride in the national flag.; asr: A father came to the bank on his own initiative to fulfill his son's promise made before his death. He wanted to repay the 24,000 yuan student loan, but when the staff saw the borrower's information, they immediately refused his request. Why was this debt that should have been repaid explicitly told by the staff that it need not be repaid? It turned out that the borrower was actually a martyr who had already sacrificed his life. His name was Li Linyu, a martyr from the Yimeng Revolutionary Base Area in Xintai, Shandong. Coming from a difficult family background, he had taken out this student loan back then to ease his family's burden and successfully complete his studies. During his time at school, he strictly completed various military skills training with excellent results and received many honors. After graduation, Li Linyu put on his military uniform and became a soldier in the Suizhou Detachment of the Hubei Provincial Corps of the Chinese People's Armed Police Force. No one expected that less than a year after enlisting, his fate would change. On the afternoon of July 12, 2022, while Li Linyu was on patrol with his comrades, he suddenly heard cries for help from the direction of the reservoir. Without a second thought, he leaped into the water to carry out a rescue. However, due to the steep slope and deep water, combined with the panicked state of the drowning person, the rescue became extremely difficult. When Li Linyu used his last bit of strength to push the person ashore, he himself sank into the water due to physical exhaustion, and his young life stopped forever at the age of 22. He was later posthumously awarded the title of one of the Twenty-fourth China Armed Police Top Ten Loyal Guards. He had once written in his diary, "There are no heroes who descend from heaven, only mortals who step forward." At that moment, there are always those who, with mortal bodies, stand shoulder to shoulder with the divine, completely transforming into giants. Just two days before his sacrifice, Li Linyu had called his parents, saying with a smile that his student loan was about to mature, telling them not to worry, that he would soon receive his salary and would repay it on time. Who could have imagined that this would become his last conversation with his family? When he enlisted, he was decorated with honors and was the pride of his entire family; when he returned, he was draped in the national flag, becoming an eternal pain in his parents' hearts. On August 5, 2022, martyr Li Linyu's ashes were buried in the Xintai Revolutionary Martyrs Cemetery. The motherland gained another hero, but his parents lost forever that sensible child. In October of the same year, Li Linyu's student loan matured. The couple, Li Xuewu and his wife, who had not yet emerged from the pain of losing their son, struggled to come to the bank, wanting to fulfill their son's final promise on his behalf. After learning of the situation, the local government immediately decided to fully waive this loan. No one is born to be used; they simply chose fearlessness at a critical moment. These are our most beloved people.; actions: type: watch, play_duration: 2, played_loop_cnt: 0, is_complete_play: False, is_fast_forward_play: False, is_backward_play: False, is_enlarge_play: False

Even after being beaten by the assailant to the point of urinary incontinence and pulmonary hemorrhage, it only howled without biting back, which shows this Malinois has excellent socialization. Because if it were a Malinois trained in protection work, I believe that person would probably have been bitten to shreds already. Secondly, when the assailant Miao XX was walking his girlfriend's unlicensed Corgi off-leash, in order to prevent his own dog from provoking the leashed and licensed Malinois, the Corgi's ear got injured. But this minor injury completely ignited Miao XX's violence. He didn't care that his own dog started the trouble first, and instead turned around to pick up a pile of empty bottles and frantically smashed them at the Malinois that couldn't break free. Every single throw accurately hit the Malinois, causing the originally docile dog lying down to let out piercing screams, its body curled up into a ball, yet powerless to resist, until even one of its teeth was knocked out. A nearby pet store employee rushed forward to intervene upon seeing this, and was even cut by Miao XX in the chaos. He even threatened that anyone who dared to stop him would be beaten too. What's even more outrageous is that Miao XX's girlfriend later distorted the facts in a dog owner chat group, falsely claiming that her Corgi was killed by the Malinois, attempting to confuse the truth. Lai Ri Da Tou put on his suit, tied his tie, and was about to go out to find work when unexpectedly, Niu Zi, a craftswoman earning billions daily, suddenly came to visit. When she saw the master and apprentice, she immediately collapsed and fainted. Her face looked haggard. Da Tou quickly brought a hot towel and water, and she gradually came around. The apprentice thought Niu Zi was trying to collect a debt in a roundabout way, because Da Tou owed her 100 yuan and hadn't paid it back for some time. But after questioning her, they learned that one of Niu Zi's clients had died. "Look at Niu Zi, she's like this over a client's death." "This is called loyalty and righteousness." "What? He had AIDS. This disease is contagious, I'm afraid I also..." "I, Niu Zi, regret it so much. I really shouldn't have accompanied people eating, drinking, and more just for some money." Niu Zi now just felt something was wrong all over her body, and any day now she might kick the bucket. "Niu Zi, if that really happens, the 100 yuan my master owes you, don't rush to collect it. Later we'll burn paper money for you instead." "Why bother with that? When death is near, money is just a worldly possession. Don't pay back the money, just like Brother Sha said, when the time comes just burn some paper money for me." Da Tou felt both sad and sorrowful upon hearing this, and Niu Zi at this moment was thinking about returning to her roots, but given her current physical condition, she feared she wouldn't make it home in time. Since Er Wai worked in the hospital cafeteria, Da Tou asked him what AIDS actually was. "You don't know until you ask - it's humanity's number one killer. Once you get it, you're done for. I can't stay longer, I need to get vegetables for the cafeteria." As soon as Er Wai left, the master and apprentice immediately got busy. The towel and cup Niu Zi had just used were directly disinfected with boiling water, and the bedding she had just lain on needed to be sun-dried and beaten. "The mortal world comes and goes." "Right, and also..." Then the floor, which hadn't been mopped in over ten years, got a thorough cleaning today. "Master, what else?" "What else? When Niu Zi came in, she was swaying and touched you." "Oh right, my clothes!" The master and apprentice carefully disinfected everywhere that had contacted Niu Zi. type: Video Browsing; caption: #RuralLife #EveryoneWorkedHard #FarmersReallyWorkHard #ThisIsTheCountryside; ocr: Autumn Harvest Life in Northeast Rural China

Autumn is the busiest season in Northeast rural areas. Every household throws itself into the intense autumn harvest work, with scenes of bustling activity in the fields. Farmers drive harvesters through the golden rice paddies, where the roar of machinery mingles with people's laughter, creating a vivid picture of abundant harvest.

Besides rice, corn is also one of the main crops in Northeast China. In the cornfields, people hold sickles and skillfully cut down the cornstalks, then strip off the corn cobs one by one and load them into bags. Although the work is hard, everyone's face beams with satisfied smiles, because this represents the reward for a year's hard labor.

The autumn harvest is not only a season of reaping but also a time for family reunions. Young people working away from home return to their hometowns one after another to help their parents complete the harvest. In the evenings, families sit together in the courtyard, enjoying the cool autumn breeze, discussing this year's harvest and future plans, in perfect harmony and happiness.

As the weather gradually turns cooler, the autumn harvest draws to a close. Farmers begin preparing to store grain, ensuring sufficient food supply for winter. At the same time, they also start planning next year's planting, looking forward to an even better harvest in the coming year. The autumn harvest life in Northeast rural areas is filled with hope and joy.; actions: type: watch, play_duration: 5, played_loop_cnt: 0, is_complete_play: False, is_fast_forward_play: False, is_backward_play: False, is_enlarge_play: False

This is the most cunning dragon I've ever seen. Just because he discovered the protagonist's dumplings were too delicious, he forcibly made a familiar contract while the protagonist wasn't paying attention. Normally, having a dragon as a familiar would be something people would desperately want, but the protagonist was completely unwilling. Most importantly, he has no human rights. Rather than being the master, he's more like a nanny serving them. We giant familiars really have it rough. He was already raising two gluttons, and now there's another ancestor to deal with. 

One day, on a whim, he decided to make dumplings. The dumpling wrappers and seasonings could be purchased from his online supermarket - a skill he brought with him when he transmigrated, allowing him to buy items from the real world using this world's currency. As for vegetables and meat, there were local options available. After some processing, he added seasonings. Since raw meat can't be tasted, seasoning must be done carefully. After kneading until sticky, he mixed it with vegetables, then came the dumpling wrapping step. Making beautiful pleats was key, which caught the slime's attention. But strangely, though using the same method, his wrapping looked somewhat different. This didn't seem like someone just learning to wrap dumplings. Before long, all the dumplings were wrapped. Since he wanted to make pan-fried dumplings, next came the frying step. First fry the dumplings until golden, then pour in water mixed with flour, drizzle some sesame oil around the pan edge, and finally - a delicious plate of pan-fried dumplings was ready.

The demon wolf and slime were seeing this food for the first time. Before the protagonist could prepare dipping sauce, they devoured everything - eating with such relish. Just as the protagonist was about to eat, an unknown creature suddenly blocked his mouth. The protagonist could tell it was a dragon, but had never seen one so small, which also surprised the demon wolf. But what surprised it was that this was actually a fairy dragon...

Cavities in tree trunks provide natural nests for many animals, so when workers process timber it's like opening a mystery box. When this tree in the footage was sawed halfway through, it gave the working laborers quite a fright. Subsequently, a huge tree hollow was discovered in another log, and sure enough, a small Komodo was hiding inside. But it was already too late.; asr: Ah. Komodo's third sister-in-law was instantly split in half on the spot. Tragic, truly tragic. This was a real scene that occurred in a lumber processing factory. In order to more conveniently transport logs out of the forest, they need to saw the massive tree trunks into slabs. The cavities within the trunks provide natural nesting places for many animals, so when workers process the lumber, it's like opening a mystery box. No one knows what they'll saw out from the next tree. In the footage, when they sawed to the middle of this particular tree, they discovered it was actually a cobra's nest. This gave the working staff quite a scare. Fortunately, it was a close call without real danger. Later, in another log, they found a huge tree hollow. The cavity was very smooth inside, clearly indicating something had been living in it for a long time. Sure enough, a small Komodo was hiding inside. description: type: Video Browsing; caption: Have you heard of "boiling eagles"? The process is like this #knowledge #boilingeagles #animals #eagles; ocr: After the eagle trainer brings the eagle back, he sits with it for four or five days straight. Although the eagle refuses to eat the food given by humans, the trainer will then take a small wooden stick to poke it and directly tie up the eagle's feet. At this point, it becomes clear to both man and eagle that it has been tamed, because most of these eagles are still in a sub-adult state.; asr: Do you know how agonizing the process of taming eagles is? Eagle tamers can't sleep for days and nights, all just to make the eagle obedient. So how exactly is the eagle tamed, and why can't they sleep? First, after the eagle tamer brings the eagle back, they tie the eagle's wings with rope, then place it on a thin wooden stick. The stick is suspended from the ceiling beams by ropes tied at both ends. To maintain balance and avoid falling, the eagle must constantly grip the stick tightly with both talons. This is when the eagle tamer comes into play. The tamer will bring a small stool and sit in front of the eagle, and this sitting lasts for four or five days. During these four or five days, neither the person nor the eagle can sleep. Because these eagles are sub-adult individuals with wild temperaments, even with their wings bound, they're still very defiant. The tamer will place chopped mutton in front of the eagle, but at this point the eagle won't eat this food that comes so easily. After a whole day passes like this, although the eagle can endure hunger and won't eat the food humans offer, it needs to sleep. Its originally vigilant eyes gradually lose their spirit, and its eyelids slowly droop. At this moment, the eagle tamer will take out musical instruments and sit beside the eagle, playing and singing. But the eagle perceives this completely differently - it only finds it extremely noisy. When the eagle becomes unbearably drowsy and the singing no longer works, the tamer will use a small stick to poke it. With just one poke, the eagle immediately perks up. After another period passes and the eagle becomes desensitized to the stick, the tamer will intensify the stimulation. The tamer will continuously shake the thin stick under the eagle's feet with their hand, making the eagle's body sway back and forth. If it still sleeps that deeply, they'll directly tie the eagle's feet and hang it upside down from the beam. Eagles aren't bats - they can't sleep hanging upside down, so they can only struggle constantly. The eagle tamer will also make various howling sounds, imitating the sounds of wild beasts on the grasslands, making the eagle feel unprecedented fear. The tamer repeats this operation at intervals, and the eagle's temper is gradually worn down bit by bit. At this point, both the person and the eagle have reached their limits. However, when the eagle tamer can't take it anymore, they can be replaced by another person, using a rotation strategy to subdue the eagle. At this point, someone might ask: eagles can't speak, so how do you know it's been tamed? This is actually very simple. Place a piece of raw mutton in your palm and extend it to the eagle. If the eagle eats it in big bites, that means it has been tamed by humans. If it doesn't eat, it can only mean it hasn't been tamed enough yet. You can also judge by petting - if the eagle tamer strokes the eagle's head and the eagle doesn't resist, that also indicates it has been tamed. Experienced eagle tamers can tell directly from the eagle's eyes whether it has submitted. Finally, the eagle can eat and sleep normally. Because most of these eagles are still in a sub-adult state, the hunter still needs to train them. To make them hunt, they must be taught to follow commands. This training process is quite simple. So being an eagle tamer isn't something just anyone can do, because the process of staying awake is truly too torturous.; actions: type: watch, play_duration: 4, played_loop_cnt: 0, is_complete_play: False, is_fast_forward_play: False, is_backward_play: False, is_enlarge_play: False

Is it because he saw the M4 win three rounds in a row? Have to say, the officer really dares to challenge. Not running isn't interesting - if you're going to catch someone, catch the strongest. Seeing... After observing several people's duels, the officer thinks the M4 is nothing special - with his skills, taking down this guy isn't a problem. Originally I thought the officer couldn't last two rounds against this guy, but unexpectedly this officer's skills are quite something. Connecting a wave of acceleration, he actually caught up ahead. Just then, several underlings came running out in a panic: "Qin Shao, Wang Ping, Zhu Hong, they're all about to be beaten to death by those Magic City people!" Whether they came to watch the excitement or were called by friends, they all rushed in.

At the same time, the Magic City rich group also arrived, a whole lineup of luxury, some even brought lawyers. "Dare to bully Magic City people? Let's see whose reputation is bigger. description: type: Video Browsing; caption: When this accident is unavoidable, what would you do? #pay attention to safety and drive carefully #safety first civilized driving #road safety driving #driving skills; ocr: Collision. Analyzing first gear. Obey traffic rules, do not drive while fatigued. Cars, first gear vintage cars, simply cannot withstand the impact. Do not imitate, please refer to actual local conditions, no negative influence intended. Better to try to avoid it as much as possible. Have relatively high expectations for vintage cars.; asr: At this moment, the black sedan symbolically moved slightly to the side, which seemed like it wanted the dashcam vehicle to squeeze through the middle. But if a collision occurred, what would have been no-fault would become at-fault. On the left was a large truck - there's no way you could win that collision. Plus, there clearly wasn't enough space. What about dodging to the side? With such a high earthen wall on the side, you couldn't drive up it, and it would easily cause a rollover. Let's see what the dashcam vehicle did. The driver chose a frontal collision, which seemed dangerous but was actually the optimal solution. During a frontal collision, the vehicle's performance structure can effectively come into play, dispersing the impact force and thereby reducing the fatality rate for occupants. Whereas in an offset collision, especially a small offset collision, such as a 25% offset crash, due to the small collision area and concentrated impact force, the vehicle's main energy-absorbing structures cannot fully participate in the collision, so the intrusion into the passenger compartment is more severe. To put it simply, it's like doing push-ups - you can do ten with both hands but only five with one hand. Of course, if you're facing one of those big iron chunks, it's still best to try to avoid it if possible. At the end of the day, when we're driving on the road, we still need to cultivate defensive driving habits.; actions: type: watch, play_duration: 39, played_loop_cnt: 0, is_complete_play: False, is_fast_forward_play: False, is_backward_play: False, is_enlarge_play: False

Modern special operations concepts were almost all created by them. From bombing airfields in WWII to counter-terrorism hostage rescue, the SAS is virtually the template for every country's special forces. In the 1980 London Embassy incident, they rappelled from the roof, blasted through windows, and rescued all hostages in eleven minutes, all broadcast live on television. description: type: Video Browsing; caption: To restore and refurbish a flood-damaged Porsche GT3RS, the guy didn't hesitate to travel between 3 countries. Despite numerous difficulties, he ultimately completed the restoration #CarRestoration #FloodDamagedCarRefurbishment #Porsche #Porsche911GT3RS; ocr: Repairing a flood-damaged car. Porsche 911 GT3 RS. Shuhong Films. But it cannot deliver fuel to the engine. As long as you have money, you can also win.; asr: Whether a water-damaged Porsche 911 GT3 RS is worth restoring, after watching this video, you'll have your answer. The guy bought a water-damaged 911 GT3 RS and learned through the auction website that it was a brand new car, just purchased from a dealer, and had an accident on the way back. It sounds like a very unfortunate incident, but fortunately there were no casualties. This car had been submerged in water for who knows how long and appeared to have no restoration value. But the guy just loves this car, and precisely because it was totaled, he was able to acquire it at a cheap price - exactly how cheap, he says he'll reveal later. The GT3 RS is a street-legal race car equipped with a 4.0-liter flat-six naturally aspirated engine that produces 525 horsepower. Its maximum RPM reaches 9,000, with 0-60 acceleration in just 3.2 seconds. Its most impressive feature is the aerodynamic system. At 200 km/h it provides 409 kg of downforce, and at top speed of 285 km/h, the downforce reaches an astonishing 860 kg, almost reaching race car levels. When the guy saw the car in person, he was shocked - it was completely different from seeing pictures. Even though his team had restored many vehicles, seeing this car made them hesitate. If it weren't a GT3 RS, he would have just parted it out. Fortunately it was submerged in fresh water - if it were seawater causing corrosion, there would really be no point in restoration. Now he just hopes the engine didn't take on water, or took on little water and hasn't rusted. The car didn't come with keys. The keys might be in the car or possibly still in the water, not yet recovered. Unfortunately, no keys were found in the car. Since the guy has no experience repairing water-damaged cars, he didn't know what to do at first. The hood looked relatively intact, so he decided to remove it first for protection. After all, this carbon fiber hood alone costs 12,000 pounds. Right after removing the hood, the guy had a sudden idea to power up the water-damaged car. A team member immediately objected - powering it up could cause an electrical fire. Well, they have fire extinguishers anyway. If the keys are in the car after powering up, the car will respond. The employee said, "You're the boss, do what you want." Oh my god love, oh my god love love love sour love my baby sour birthday what's up your... The dashboard didn't respond. The guy's father suggested the fuses might be blown. After checking, indeed several fuses were blown. After replacing them, the dashboard still didn't respond, so he stopped worrying about finding the keys. More importantly, he needed to lift the chassis to check the transmission and engine. If both are damaged, the car really isn't worth repairing. After lifting the chassis, they found the skid plate intact, so no need to worry about impact damage to the transmission. More importantly, checking the engine - luckily it looked pretty good on the surface. Best case scenario now would be to drain the oil and refill it, that would be perfect. What it's actually like, they'll only know after draining the oil. Oil and water don't mix - if oil comes out first, that means there's no water in the engine, since water is heavier than oil. Result: after removing the drain plug, all water came out. Now they can only hope the interior hasn't rusted. They removed the spark plugs and used a borescope to check - the inspection results were very disappointing. There was enough water inside to keep fish, and it was covered in rust. It seems you can't be lucky about anything, or reality will teach you a harsh lesson. To continue restoration, they'll have to remove the engine. Since this car has a flat-six engine, they can only first point three cylinders upward, add rust remover and oil, let it penetrate to remove rust, let it sit for a while, then flip it over. If it still can't completely remove the rust, they'll have no choice but to disassemble the engine. Next comes the tedious and meticulous disassembly. After removing the wheels, they discovered the entire aluminum alloy wheel had broken into two pieces, showing how fast the car was going and how hard the impact was. Now the engine has been removed, and you can see it's full of rusty water. They mounted the engine on a stand for easier operation, rotated the engine to let water flow out from the cylinder openings. With a flick of his hand, a silver badge with an exclusive number gleamed coldly in his palm. The moment the badge appeared, the Fengyi team members were struck as if by lightning. Wait, what is that? Isn't that the Fengyi Supreme Command badge that Old Lin has? How did it end up in Peak's hands? You're sure you only follow Miss Lin's orders? Peak stepped forward and slowly raised the badge. Fengyi Special Forces, listen up. I'm now taking over. All team members, line up and await my orders. Stand at attention!

Long Yun finally lowered her proud head and knelt. Peak, I'm sorry, we were wrong. Then the Fengyi team members uniformly said, "Young Master Peak, we were wrong." Holy crap, the Fengyi Special Forces knelt! The legendary two most mysterious guard teams are now both under Young Master Peak's command. What level of existence is Young Master Peak? Can anyone handle this?

Lin Shusi bit her lip, her fingers digging into her palms, completely unable to accept the humiliation before her. They're my people. What gives you the right to command them? Where did you get that badge? What did you say to my father? I said nothing. Your father gave it to me voluntarily. With that, he turned and left.

At that moment, on the street, an all-black customized bulletproof sedan sat quietly in the shadows. Inside sat none other than... He had witnessed the entire scene. Old Lin, Peak was too presumptuous. Not only did he hit Miss Lin, but he also made the Fengyi members kneel. When has the young miss ever suffered such humiliation? Presumptuous? I don't think so. He did nothing wrong. He did very well. You think he was acting wild? Wrong. He was controlling the situation. If he hadn't forcefully suppressed the situation, who knows what that Kong Jia kid might have done. That slap wasn't just on Lin Shusi's face—it was a wake-up call for the Lin family's young generation.

That Kong Chuan kid—if Peak hadn't come, Lin Shusi would definitely have been dragged down by him. Shusi is like her mother, but unfortunately too accustomed to everyone revolving around her. Today, let her see with her own eyes that not everyone will indulge her, and not everyone fears her. People are just wary of her status, wary of my authority. But Peak is different. He's one of the few young people I've seen who can stir up trouble, handle it, and control the situation—a person with both courage and strategy. Perhaps in the future, he'll be able to shoulder the great responsibility of the Gu family.

Old Lin, what about Miss Lin and Peak in the future? They'll definitely meet again. Will they clash? They're both young people. As for how they'll interact in the future, you and I will eventually retire. The Lin family always needs someone who can hold the fort. Peak understands some things too. It just depends on whether Peak is willing to take it on.

As vehicles gradually left the scene, the ancient city of the capital, woven by power, quieted down once more. Time passed, and a week went by. At the end of June, summer heat waves rolled through the capital. The storm involving the capital's young miss and young master from a week ago still lingered in various circles. Yet Peak, at the center of the storm, had quietly disappeared.

He understood clearly that this wasn't about who was right or wrong, but that he had used extreme measures to strike at the dignity of the Lin family's younger generation. So these days, he'd been waiting—waiting for outside reactions, waiting for his father to blame him. Just as Peak was feeling anxious, the principal called.

Young Master Peak, no, Student Peak, the university is about to start summer vacation. Today is this semester's outstanding graduate commendation ceremony. Just as I was hesitating, bullet comments appeared before my eyes saying "What a sucker, here comes the male lead." First, she wants to sleep in; second, her daughter is vain and doesn't want to take a little electric scooter to the exam - thinks it's embarrassing. I calmly watched the bullet comments popping up before me. Just as I was about to close the door, the neighbor blocked my way. "If that won't work, lend me your car for three days. I'll drive my daughter to the exam, and you can ride my electric scooter to work. Isn't there a saying that 'distant relatives aren't as good as close neighbors'? If you help me today, when your family needs help in the future, we won't shirk either." At this point, Duanwu was even more agitated than me. "OK. Human kindness isn't meant to be wasted on idiots like you. When others ask for help, they bring snacks and fruit. I'll emphasize one more time: I won't lend you the car, and I won't drive your daughter to the exam. If you don't leave, I'll call property management." description:
type: Video Browsing; caption: Episode 34 | The Rich Young Master's Peak #original animation #2D #content inspiration sharing program; ocr: This is fictional and for entertainment purposes only. Do not imitate dangerous behavior. If he hadn't forcefully suppressed the situation back then, I would have already reached my peak.; asr: # Translation

Long Yun, kill him now, kill him for me. He's shooting. We dare to shoot. We only obey orders from Miss Lin. Everyone prepare. Just then, Peak betrayed them. With a flick of his hand, a silver badge with an exclusive number gleamed coldly in his palm. The moment the badge appeared, the Fengyi team members were struck as if by lightning. Wait, what is that? Isn't that the Fengyi Supreme Command badge that Old Lin has? How did it end up in Peak's hands? You're sure you only follow Miss Lin's orders? Peak stepped forward and slowly raised the badge. Fengyi Special Forces, listen up. I'm now taking command of you. All members, line up and await my orders. Stand at attention!

Holy shit, Peak can actually mobilize the Fengyi Special Forces? Damn, this is insane. I don't believe it. How do you have this badge? Peak ignored Lin Shusi. All Fengyi Special Forces members, make your Miss Lin kneel and apologize to me. Peak, we Fengyi have never knelt to anyone. I don't want to see you kneel. What I want is your attitude. At this moment, everyone at the scene began exchanging glances, all understanding that Peak wasn't threatening or posturing—he was taking over Fengyi.

Long Yun finally lowered her proud head and knelt. Peak, I'm sorry, we were wrong. Then the Fengyi members uniformly said, Peak, we were wrong. Holy crap, the Fengyi Special Forces knelt! The two legendary most mysterious guard teams are now both under Peak's command. What level of existence is Peak exactly? Can this hold up? Lin Shusi bit her lip, her fingers digging into her palms, completely unable to accept the humiliation before her. They're my people. What gives you the right to command them? Where did you get that badge? What did you say to my father? I said nothing. Your father gave it to me voluntarily. With that, he turned and left.

At that moment, on the street, an all-black custom bulletproof sedan sat quietly in the shadows. Inside sat none other than... He had witnessed the entire scene. Old Lin, Peak was too presumptuous. Not only did he hit Miss Lin, but he also made the Fengyi members kneel. When has the young miss ever suffered such humiliation? Presumptuous? I don't think so. He did nothing wrong. He did very well. You think he was acting wild? Wrong. He was controlling the situation. If he hadn't forcefully suppressed the situation, who knows what that Kong Jia kid might have done. That slap wasn't just on Lin Shusi's face—it was a wake-up call for the Lin family's young generation.

Kong Chuan—if Peak hadn't come, Lin Shusi would definitely have been dragged down by him. Shusi is like her mother, but unfortunately too accustomed to everyone revolving around her. Today, let her see with her own eyes that not everyone will indulge her, and not everyone fears her. People are merely wary of her status, wary of my authority. But Peak is different. He's one of the few young people I've seen who can stir up trouble, handle it, and control the situation—someone with both courage and strategy. Perhaps in the future, he'll be able to shoulder the great responsibility of the Gu family. Old Lin, what about Miss Lin and Peak in the future? They'll definitely meet again. Will they clash? They're both young people. As for how they'll interact in the future, you and I will eventually retire. The Lin family always needs someone who can hold the fort. Peak understands some things too. It just depends on whether he's willing to take on the responsibility.

As vehicles gradually left the scene, the ancient city of the capital, woven by power, quieted down once more. Time passed, and a week went by. At the end of June, summer heat waves rolled through the capital. The storm involving the capital's young miss and the capital's prince from a week ago still lingered in various circles. Yet Peak, at the center of the storm, had quietly disappeared. description: type: Video Browsing; ocr: Online class in reality. The three people walked to a corner to continue their conversation. Dad, I've arrived in Beijing, lend me 1000 yuan. I'll pay you back when I get my salary. Asking him to borrow money from family is even more the foundation of mutual trust in society.; asr: A recent college graduate never imagined that upon entering society, she would be taught four harsh lessons by reality. The first wave consisted of two young women who proactively approached Xiao Zhang to strike up a conversation. After a few minutes, the two girls led her to a corner, and the three kept talking about something. After half an hour, the two girls left. Just as Xiao Zhang squatted down to organize her belongings, the second wave arrived—two different women. The three conversed for about twenty minutes. During this time, Xiao Zhang took out her phone several times, seemingly inputting some information. After the chat ended, Xiao Zhang and the two girls separated and headed toward the subway station, but she hadn't walked more than a few steps when the third wave appeared—a man showed up first. This man walked alongside Xiao Zhang for a stretch before stopping, and the two talked for over ten minutes. Just then, a woman in pink approached and joined the conversation. Shortly after, the man left, and the woman in pink continued talking with Xiao Zhang for another 40-plus minutes. After the woman in pink left, the fourth wave arrived—two men appeared. They chatted and laughed with Xiao Zhang at first, then after a few minutes, one of the men put his hand on Xiao Zhang's shoulder while the other helped pull her luggage. The three moved to a corner to continue their conversation. During this entire period, a total of eight people took turns talking with Xiao Zhang over the course of four hours. Unexpectedly, more than ten days later, Xiao Zhang went to the police station to file a report, saying she had been swindled out of over 8,000 yuan by these eight young people. The reason for being scammed was that she had bought pens these young people were selling. It turned out that the first wave of two women stopped Xiao Zhang to complain about their hardships. They claimed to be college students doing internships just like Xiao Zhang, and said they would be fired if their sales performance didn't meet targets. They then tried to sell Xiao Zhang gel pens priced at 198 yuan each. Although she had no need for pens, faced with the two girls' almost pleading appeals, Xiao Zhang softened. So she bought two gel pens and some refills, spending a total of 520 yuan. Unexpectedly, as soon as the first group left, the second group approached her with the same reason—selling pens. The second wave also consisted of two young women hoping to gain Xiao Zhang's help. Unable to refuse, Xiao Zhang spent another 198 yuan to buy a pen. But before she could recover, the third wave had already caught up with her. Facing the third group, Xiao Zhang clearly stated she didn't want to buy any more pens. Seeing that persuasion was ineffective, the woman who claimed to be the team leader immediately changed tactics, hoping to borrow some money from Xiao Zhang, promising to return it that evening.
