description: type: Video Browsing; caption: Those greasy meals that are hard to swallow are actually his life-saving food! #ContentInspirationSharingPlan #BrotherLi #IntestinalObstruction; ocr: Replying to Fat Cat Chi Yu. The unpalatable food is his life-sustaining meal. Yet it has been his life-sustaining diet for decades. Fat Cat Chi Yu. His daily meals are either soybean oil mixed with noodles or lard with fatty meat. Sometimes he simply scoops lard and dips it in soybean paste to eat. At first, people thought he was just seeking attention, but upon learning more, they discovered the truth. This blogger with a disabled left eye cannot afford intestinal obstruction surgery due to financial constraints, and can only rely on this high-oil, high-fat diet to clear his intestines and maintain his health. Illness hasn't spared him either—his intestines often suddenly become inflamed, and once inflamed, he needs IV drips. Those greasy "life-sustaining meals" must be temporarily set aside, but when the inflammation subsides slightly, he has to start eating soybean oil and fatty meat again, enduring his physical discomfort through this repetitive cycle. He worries that viewers will tire of the repetitive dishes. Every day the dishes are the same—his physical limitations prevent variation—yet he still proactively explains: it's not that he doesn't want to change, but his physical condition simply doesn't allow it. Even though repeatedly tormented by illness, he's grateful that Douyin officials have allowed Brother Li to meet so many friends here and given him the opportunity to showcase himself. He faces tomorrow with an optimistic attitude, confident that dreams will come true! Having the fortune to meet leaders in this life has further increased his confidence. He faces life with sunshine and enjoys every day! Brother Li loves singing, dancing, and eating fatty meat. Fatty meat is essential for his body, and drinking moderate amounts of oil is also what Brother Li's body needs. These are part of his life. In this lifetime, one must be content and happy—just be happy! Brother Li has never conveyed even a hint of negative energy. name: Episode 71: Don't Make Me Show My Badge #OriginalAnimation #2D
description: type: Video Browsing; caption: Episode 71: Don't Make Me Show My Badge #OriginalAnimation #2D; ocr: Rampage at the Jiang family. Original by Xiachenyu. Don't be confrontational the moment you meet, you must drive the car away.; asr: Dad, I know you love drinking infused liquor, so I specifically searched the entire country for master brewers and managed to get this premium bottle. It cost me nearly 3 million! Even my brother-in-law's connections only found liquor with 12 venomous snakes, but mine has a full 13! Zhuang Fei praised this liquor to the skies, not knowing that others listening felt uncomfortable, especially Old Zhuang. The scene of him being bitten last time was still vivid, as if it happened yesterday. "Feifei, how could you give Dad infused liquor? Don't you know that I—" "What's wrong with me giving Dad infused liquor? Dad loves this the most. As his daughter, what's wrong with showing some filial piety? Why do you dislike it so much? Didn't my brother-in-law also go through great efforts to get a lot of liquor? But it all went to entertaining guests and giving gifts, and Dad never got to drink any. Dad raised us through hardship, being both father and mother. Now that he's retired, can't he drink something good?" Zhuang Fei's words were the epitome of passive-aggressiveness and scheming. Without once mentioning her own filial piety, every sentence accused Zhuang Yan and Fang Ruiyang of being unfilial. She had mastered the art of putting herself on a pedestal to perfection. "So you're the only filial one, and we're all ungrateful? Do you know that this infused liquor almost cost him his life? Tell me, what are your real intentions?" "What are you saying? Speak clearly! How did I suddenly have ulterior motives? This liquor was just brought out, the lid hasn't even been opened yet. How could it have almost cost him his life?" At this point, the entire private room was filled with thick tension. The old woman in the back was secretly overjoyed. "Wonderful! Fight, hurry up and fight! The more heated, the better!" "Enough! Can you sisters not be at each other's throats every time you meet? You're both in your thirties, yet you still act like you're a few years old or teenagers." Now both of them fell silent. At this moment, Fang Xi, that brilliant one, suddenly jumped out to add fuel to the fire. "Auntie, you should save this filial piety. Grandpa won't drink it. Last time at my house, Grandpa took one sip of my dad's infused liquor and was immediately bitten by a snake. Now you're giving Grandpa infused liquor again—you're really asking for trouble." "What? Dad drank infused liquor at your house and was bitten by a snake? Sis, what's going on with you and Fang Ruiyang? How dare you give Dad liquor that wasn't properly prepared? Isn't this deliberately trying to harm someone? Was it you on purpose or Fang Ruiyang on purpose?" "Zhuang Fei, don't be so vicious with your words. What do you mean Ruiyang and I deliberately wanted to harm Dad? All you do is talk nonsense all day long." "Fine, sis! You say I want to harm Dad? Then let's not drink any of this liquor!" As soon as Zhuang Fei finished speaking, she forcefully smashed the chair in her hand against the liquor jar. It shattered into pieces, and the venomous snakes, medicinal herbs, and liquor inside spilled out all over the table. Old Zhuang looked on with heartache. "Feifei, even if you're angry, you didn't have to smash the liquor. I haven't even had a sip yet!" Then Old Zhuang quickly stood up and picked up a cup, wanting to salvage some of the remaining liquor to drink. However, at that moment, unexpectedly, a five-pace viper from the snake pile suddenly bit hard into Old Zhuang's arm. The old man ultimately couldn't get that drink after all. Old Zhuang instinctively shook violently, flinging the five-pace viper onto Zhuang Yan. The viper smoothly slid into her skirt. "Help! Li Ma, get it away!" Zhuang Yan frantically panicked while ordering. The old woman secretly rolled her eyes. "I only get paid a few bucks a month by you. Why should I care about this?" Finally, the viper was removed. As soon as it hit the ground, it crawled outside, returning to nature. "I was bitten!" "Are you okay?" "Because its fangs are still in my arm." Everyone looked closely and discovered that two venomous fangs were still embedded in Old Zhuang's arm. Presumably, the snake had been soaking in the liquor for so long that it had developed osteoporosis. Zhuang Yan immediately breathed a sigh of relief, then reacted. "Dad, how are you? Call someone! Mom, what are you standing there for? Call someone! Quick, someone come! Old Master Zhuang has been bitten by a snake again!" The farm owner's wife immediately rushed over with several workers in a panic. When she saw that the person bitten was Old Zhuang, she felt like the sky was falling. "Quick, get him to the hospital first!" However, when the group arrived at the road, they were dumbfounded on the spot, because Zhuang Yan and Zhuang Fei

name: Male protagonist summons mecha to participate in competition #anime commentary #
description:
type: Video Browsing; caption: Male protagonist summons mecha to participate in competition #anime commentary #anime recommendation #2D #anime; ocr: And the title he was about to receive, Leo only gave a light pat with the shovel, but in reality he was just too jealous of the prince's good looks. The other party was obviously deliberately picking a fight, however an uninvited guest arrived that evening.; asr: # Translation

The male protagonist bows 90 degrees toward the sky, and suddenly an iron box descends from above - this is the mecha he summoned. The next second, everyone present bursts into laughter. Even Angelita finds it incredibly hard to believe. Leo's mecha is an outdated model that's long been discontinued, completely unable to compete with these new-type machines. Leo ignores everyone's mockery and enters the cockpit to activate this clunky mecha. Leo's first opponent is this cat boy, the most attention-seeking among the prince's four subordinates and also a magician. His mecha is custom-made by a famous craftsman, using large amounts of mineral ore materials that greatly enhance magic conductivity. Just as he's feeling proud, Leo decides to bring out a weapon to match, but unexpectedly ends up with a shovel - thanks to Leo's frequent farming. With no choice now, he'll have to make do with this shovel. This draws mockery from everyone again, little knowing they'll soon be proven wrong. At the referee's signal, the match officially begins. Purple Hair wants to defeat Leo in one move by activating the magic swords behind him. Leo's mecha appears heavier but is actually extremely agile. After dodging all the attacks, before Purple Hair can react, Leo simply gives a light tap with his shovel, knocking Purple Hair unconscious. Yet Leo hasn't even used his full strength. The referee determines Purple Hair has lost consciousness. Just like that, amid everyone's stunned expressions, Leo easily wins the first match. Seeing the audience's shocked faces, Angelica laughs heartily - it seems trusting Leo was right. After witnessing Leo's overwhelming strength, Green Hair realizes this might be the legendary lost artifact. description: type: Video Browsing; caption: Someone asked what would be most valuable if war broke out? #NeverExpected #War #Rural; ocr: Little Bear Commentary. And there's no bombing value whatsoever. Some people ask, once war breaks out, many people might first think of gold, but reality is often harsh. Gold in Western countries doesn't even make the top three among essential items. If you don't believe it, look at the Russia-Ukraine conflict and Middle East wars - what they attack first are hospitals and airports. When that time comes, you'll find it instantly becomes worthless. Leaving the city becomes the top priority, because once the network collapses, electronic payments and bank cards become useless. The first things they attack are hospitals, airports, power grids and other critical targets. You'll find that a house you bought for 1 million instantly becomes worthless. So leaving the city before war starts becomes the top priority. Step one: go to the bank and withdraw cash, because once the network goes down, electronic payments and bank cards become useless. Step two: fill up your gas tank, and if possible, stock up on extra fuel. Final step: take your valuables and drive back to your rural hometown, because in war, aside from essential supplies, the most valuable thing is a rural home. It's not only far from cities, but also has no bombing value whatsoever. A single missile costs hundreds of thousands or millions - no enemy would be stupid enough to waste it bombing your few single-story houses. I'm sorry, but Fengcheng Prison is under orders from the Wutong Command - no one is allowed to enter. Suddenly, Peak twisted his wrist and pointed the Beretta directly at one person's forehead, "Get lost right now!" "Oh, is this the young master Dian from the capital? I'm sorry, Young Master Dian, but without a pass order you cannot enter. Also, you need to state your reason for visiting." "I need a reason to come here?" "Young Master Dian, we have our orders. This matter really cannot... Let me go report to the leadership first." "Then hurry up and go!" As soon as the words fell, several soldiers ran inside to report. "Let me tell you first, I'm helping you..." "What? Young Master Dian, Wang Hao has been arrested? No, there's also Miss Lin from the capital, Lin Shusi is here too?" "What? He also has friends coming in? No, I heard from other soldiers reporting. Those two seem to be talking about something, uncle, seems to be here for Mr. Kong." Hearing the words "Mr. Kong," Yan Ding's eyes flashed - impossible, absolutely impossible. "Others I might turn a blind eye to, but coming for Mr. Kong? He's about to be executed soon, no one can see him." A few minutes later, the gate slowly opened. Yan Ding's face was iron-blue, followed by several prison guards. "Miss Lin, I'm very sorry. Fengcheng Prison is the highest-level execution institution. Without a pass order, no one may visit anyone. I hope you both understand." "You're the person in charge?" "Yes, yes, I'm the person in charge." "Good, as long as you're in charge. Let me ask you - today, are you going to let me in, or are you going in?" The air froze instantly, everyone's faces changed dramatically. Just as Peak walked toward Yan Ting step by step, applying continuous pressure, Lin Shusi suddenly stepped forward. "Hello, Commander Yan, could you please accommodate us? I just want to see my uncle once. He's been in prison all these years and the family is very worried. Even just one glance would be good." As expected, Yan Ting immediately regained confidence. "I'm sorry, Miss Lin. As far as I know, your uncle is a serious financial criminal. The verdict has already been handed down. If you want to visit, please bring a pass order. Otherwise, no one has the right to visit. Young Master Dian, as far as I know, this Mr. Kong should have nothing to do with you, right? Oh, please don't misunderstand me. What I mean is, if this matter gets out that you and Miss Lin came to visit together, wouldn't it cause unnecessary trouble for you?" The guards all gasped when they heard this. Just when everyone thought Peak would explode in anger... "Wait, didn't you say you'd help me?" "How could what he said be right? He just doesn't want to let me see my uncle." A barely noticeable smirk appeared on his face as he mysteriously pulled her aside. "See? This isn't easy to handle. Why don't you give me the Fengyi Medal now?" "Oh, why are you so anxious? I already trust you. After this is done, I'll definitely return it to you. Besides, I didn't bring it at all. Really didn't bring it. If you don't believe me, search me." "You're really something." As he said, both pockets were indeed empty. "You still have a pocket inside your coat." "You're talking nonsense!" Lin Shusi instinctively stepped back half a step, guarding her chest. Peak didn't care, grabbed her directly - no tenderness in his eyes, only desire for the medal. "Hey, what are you doing?" Before Lin Shusi could resist, Peak had already put his hand into her coat, into the small inner pocket close to her body. Before feeling anything clearly, a soft sensation fell into his palm. The air went quiet for a moment. "Seems like there really isn't any." This scene left Yan Ting and others completely dumbfounded. At the same time, Old Lin also received information about the situation at Fengcheng Prison gate. Rather than saying he received it, it's better to say he was monitoring it in real-time. "Do you think Peak will really help uncle rescue Mr. Kong?" "Uh, judging from the current situation, this matter seems a bit difficult." "According to what you're saying, maybe I should give them a call." The verdict regarding Mr. Kong was basically all decided by Old Lin. Mr. Kong was guilty, but not deserving of death. "Young Master Dian, although you are the son of an elder, Fengcheng Prison has its own discipline and procedures. Without a pass order, it's not a place anyone can enter just because they want to." After listening, he looked at the rows of soldiers behind him. "There are 500 people here - 500 directly subordinate armed guards who have assisted Fengcheng Prison for many years.
